title: 魔物：三视图参照与按体型的动作表

subject.zh: 体长约半米（连尾）的大鼠，四足贴地、弓背；粗硬短毛灰褐 #6B6359，背上散着一块块更暗的灰斑 #4A443D，眼白发灰；裸露的长尾粉灰 #C9A9A0；门齿外露，以扑咬攻击；辨识：尾与身一样长，耳小而圆。
subject.en: A big rat about half a meter long including the tail, four legs low to the ground, arched back; coarse short gray-brown fur #6B6359 with darker gray blotches #4A443D across the back, grayish whites of the eyes; a long bare pinkish-gray tail #C9A9A0; protruding front incisors, attacks with lunging bites; identifying marks: tail as long as the body, small round ears.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：灰斑的背毛与外露的门齿。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the blotched back fur and the protruding incisors.

items.notes: 先做本条：主审通过后它是本主体全部动作表的参照图。M0 全链路样板之一。灰斑只比底色暗一级，不要画成发光或紫色。

subject.zh: 高约 0.7 米的一团灰烬色黏稠澱渣，没有骨骼与四肢，底部摊开、顶部隆起；表面像湿灰浆 #5C5A57，夹着更暗的渣块 #3A3836 与几粒淡紫微光点 #C6B5E0；靠整团扑压攻击；辨识：表面嵌着两三块门框形的小碎石。
subject.en: A blob of ash-gray sticky sediment about 0.7 m tall, no skeleton or limbs, spread out at the base and domed on top; the surface looks like wet ash plaster #5C5A57 with darker clinker lumps #3A3836 and a few pale lavender specks #C6B5E0; attacks by flopping its whole mass forward; identifying mark: two or three small door-frame-shaped stone chips embedded in its surface.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：嵌在表面的门框形小碎石。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the small door-frame-shaped chips in its surface.

subject.zh: 翼展约 0.9 米的渡鸦，单只立牌（成群时由多只实例组成）；黑羽 #1F1F24 带蓝灰光泽 #3C3C46，羽尖散着灰白斑；眼珠暗金 #D9B45A；以粗喙与爪俯冲啄抓；辨识：喙粗厚而弯，颈下一团蓬松喉羽，尾呈楔形。
subject.en: A raven with a wingspan of about 0.9 m, drawn as a single bird (a flock is several instances); black plumage #1F1F24 with a blue-gray sheen #3C3C46, gray-white flecks at the feather tips; dark gold eyes #D9B45A; dives to peck and claw with a heavy beak and talons; identifying marks: thick curved beak, shaggy throat feathers, wedge-shaped tail.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：粗厚弯喙与蓬松喉羽。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the heavy curved beak and shaggy throat feathers.

items.notes: 先做本条：主审通过后它是本主体全部动作表的参照图。每格只画一只鸦，群体由渲染层用多只实例错开相位；它是普通大小的鸦，不要画成首领那样的巨鸟。

subject.zh: 体长约 1.6 米、肩高约 0.8 米的灰狼，四足；厚毛灰色 #8A8D8F，背脊与尾尖深一级 #5F6264，吻部、胸口与腿内侧浅灰白 #D8D4CC；眼琥珀色；以獠牙扑咬；辨识：竖耳、长吻、蓬松下垂的尾巴，未受澱染的干净毛色。
subject.en: A gray wolf about 1.6 m long and 0.8 m at the shoulder, four legs; thick gray fur #8A8D8F, one step darker along the spine and tail tip #5F6264, pale gray-white #D8D4CC on the muzzle, chest and inner legs; amber eyes; attacks with lunging fangs; identifying marks: upright ears, long muzzle, bushy drooping tail, a clean untainted coat.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：竖耳长吻的头部与獠牙。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the head with upright ears, long muzzle and fangs.

subject.zh: 腿展约 1.2 米的大蜘蛛，八条节腿、两节身体（头胸与圆鼓的腹）；甲壳暗苔绿 #3A3F37，腹背有灰白 #A9B29A 的网格纹，关节挂着灰色丝絮；以一对弯螯咬刺、腹尖喷灰丝；辨识：前两腿最长，腹部的灰白网格纹。
subject.en: A large spider with a legspan of about 1.2 m, eight jointed legs and two body parts (cephalothorax and a round swollen abdomen); dark moss-green carapace #3A3F37, a gray-white #A9B29A lattice pattern on the abdomen, gray silk tufts caught at the joints; bites with a pair of curved fangs and sprays gray silk from the abdomen tip; identifying marks: the longest front pair of legs, the gray-white lattice on the abdomen.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：弯螯与腹背的灰白网格纹。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the curved fangs and the gray-white lattice on the abdomen.

items.notes: 先做本条：主审通过后它是本主体全部动作表的参照图。八条腿，每帧数一遍。

subject.zh: 身高约 1.7 米的人形骸骨，两足直立、微佝偻；骨色是发黄的旧象牙 #D8D0BC，关节积灰 #9C947E，挂着式样古旧的破粗布短衣；眼窝里两点淡紫微光 #C6B5E0；以锈短剑或骨爪抓击；辨识：胸骨上缺了一块门框形的缺口。
subject.en: A humanoid skeleton about 1.7 m tall, standing on two legs with a slight stoop; bones of yellowed old ivory #D8D0BC with ash caked in the joints #9C947E, hanging rags of an old-fashioned coarse tunic; two faint lavender glints #C6B5E0 in the eye sockets; strikes with a rusted short sword or bony claws; identifying mark: a door-frame-shaped notch missing from the breastbone.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：胸骨上门框形的缺口与眼窝微光。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the door-frame-shaped notch in the breastbone and the glints in the sockets.

subject.zh: 高约 1.8 米的人形怨灵，下半身散成烟缕，没有腿，悬在离地一掌处；身体像冷灰蓝的雾 #9FB3C2，轮廓深一级 #5E7180，脸只有两个空洞的眼和张开的嘴；以细长手爪抓挠；辨识：残留着褪色的古式头巾与衣襟，衣襟中间破出一个门形空洞。
subject.en: A humanoid wraith about 1.8 m tall whose lower body trails off into wisps, no legs, floating a hand's breadth above the ground; its body is a cold gray-blue mist #9FB3C2 with edges one step darker #5E7180, a face of only two hollow eyes and an open mouth; claws with long thin hands; identifying marks: faded remains of an ancient-style headscarf and robe front, with a door-shaped hole through the middle of the robe.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：空洞的眼口与衣襟上的门形空洞。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the hollow eyes and mouth and the door-shaped hole in the robe.

subject.zh: 直径约 1 米的悬浮球状澱灵，没有肢体与脸；核心是一团暗灰蓝的旋涡 #4B4F5A，外层缠着三四圈灰烟缕 #A7ADBD，中心嵌着一枚澱紫 #4A3A62 的晶核；以烟缕抽打与冲撞攻击；辨识：烟缕始终绕晶核同一方向旋转。
subject.en: A floating spherical sediment spirit about 1 m across, no limbs and no face; its core is a dark gray-blue whorl #4B4F5A wrapped in three or four loops of gray smoke #A7ADBD, a sediment-violet #4A3A62 crystal core at its center; attacks by lashing smoke trails and ramming; identifying mark: the smoke loops always circle the core in the same direction.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：中心的澱紫晶核与环绕的烟缕。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the violet crystal core and the circling smoke loops.

subject.zh: 体长约半米的野兔，四足，后腿长而有力；毛色土黄褐 #A07F5A，背上杂着深褐细纹 #6B5238，腹部与尾下白 #E8E2D4；长耳竖立、耳尖黑；受惊即逃，被逼急时用后腿蹬踢；辨识：黑尖长耳与上翘的短白尾，干净的野生毛色。
subject.en: A wild hare about half a meter long, four legs with long powerful hind legs; tawny brown fur #A07F5A streaked with dark brown #6B5238 on the back, white belly and tail underside #E8E2D4; long upright black-tipped ears; flees when startled and kicks with its hind legs when cornered; identifying marks: black-tipped long ears and a short upturned white tail, clean wild coloring.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：黑尖长耳与上翘白尾。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the black-tipped long ears and upturned white tail.

subject.zh: 体长约 1.5 米的野猪，四足短粗，前身高、后身低；粗硬鬃毛黑褐 #4A3A2C，背脊一道竖立的长鬃，吻部灰粉 #9C8B7A；下颌一对上翘的白獠牙 #E6DCC8；低头冲撞、以獠牙挑刺；辨识：楔形长吻与背脊长鬃，干净的野生毛色。

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：楔形长吻与上翘獠牙。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the wedge-shaped snout and upturned tusks.

subject.zh: 体长约 0.8 米的甲虫，六条短粗节腿、头上一对锯齿大颚；鞘翅像生锈的铁板，锈红 #8A4A2A 与铁褐 #5A3A28 斑驳相间，缝里渗出灰白锈粉；腹下嵌着几粒灰晶；以大颚夹咬、喷锈粉；辨识：鞘翅上一排排铆钉似的圆凸。
subject.en: A beetle about 0.8 m long with six short thick jointed legs and a pair of serrated mandibles; wing cases like rusted iron plates, mottled rust red #8A4A2A and iron brown #5A3A28, gray-white rust powder seeping from the seams; a few gray crystals set in its underside; pinches with its mandibles and puffs corrosive rust dust; identifying marks: rows of rivet-like round bumps on the wing cases.

extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the serrated mandibles and rivet-like bumps on the wing cases.

subject.zh: 身高约 1.7 米的亡灵哨兵，两足直立；焦黑干皮 #3A2A24 贴在骨上，穿烧焦的旧式皮甲与无边铁盔 #5A5A58，腰挂一只凹瘪的铜哨；胸口一道始终渗着暗红 #B33A2A 的刀伤；以锈长矛刺击；辨识：铁盔前沿一道火燎黑痕，矛上缠着破哨旗。
subject.en: An undead sentry about 1.7 m tall, standing on two legs; scorched dry hide #3A2A24 clinging to bone, burnt old-style leather armor and a brimless iron helm #5A5A58, a dented brass whistle at the belt; a sword wound across the chest that always seeps dark red #B33A2A; thrusts with a rusted spear; identifying marks: a fire-blackened streak along the helm's brow, a tattered watch pennant wrapped around the spear.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：烧焦的铁盔与渗红的胸口刀伤。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the scorched helm and the seeping chest wound.

subject.zh: 高约 0.8 米的一团悬浮冷火，没有身体与肢体；火焰外层青白 #9DB4C8、内层暗红 #5A1A16，火芯是一粒澱紫 #4A3A62 的暗核，火舌末端拖着细碎灰烬；以扑身灼烧攻击；辨识：火焰上缘总是分成三股上卷，底下吊着一缕根须似的细烟。
subject.en: A floating cold flame about 0.8 m tall with no body or limbs; pale blue-white outer flame #9DB4C8, dark red inner flame #5A1A16, a sediment-violet #4A3A62 dark kernel at its heart, its tongues trailing fine ash; attacks by lunging to scorch; identifying marks: the top of the flame always splits into three curling tongues, a thin root-like wisp of smoke hangs beneath it.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：三股上卷的火舌与澱紫火芯。

subject.zh: 站高约 0.9 米、翼展约 1.5 米的白鹭，两条细长黑腿，S 形长颈；全身洁白羽 #F2F0E8，背上披着蓑状细羽，嘴黑而尖 #2A2A2A，脚趾黄绿；受惊即飞，被逼时以尖嘴啄刺；辨识：脑后两根细长冠羽，飞行时颈缩成 S 形。
subject.en: A white egret about 0.9 m tall with a 1.5 m wingspan, two long thin black legs and a long S-curved neck; pure white plumage #F2F0E8 with lacy plumes draped over the back, a sharp black bill #2A2A2A, yellow-green toes; flies off when startled and stabs with its bill when cornered; identifying marks: two long thin plumes at the back of the head, neck folded in an S in flight.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：脑后两根冠羽与尖黑嘴。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the two head plumes and the sharp black bill.

subject.zh: 直径约 1 米的一团野蜂群，二三十只拇指大的蜂聚成蓬松的球；蜂身琥珀黄 #C8962A 与黑褐 #3A2A18 相间，翅膀是浅灰小块；团心裹着一小片蜂巢碎块 #D8B860；以整团扑上叮刺；辨识：外缘总有几只离群打转，整团像一朵起伏的云。
subject.en: A swarm of wild bees about 1 m across, twenty or thirty thumb-sized bees gathered into a loose ball; bodies banded amber yellow #C8962A and black-brown #3A2A18, wings as small pale gray flecks; a scrap of honeycomb #D8B860 tucked in its middle; attacks by mobbing and stinging as a whole; identifying marks: a few stragglers always circling at the edge, the whole swarm shaped like a heaving cloud.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：团心的蜂巢碎块与外缘打转的蜂。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the honeycomb scrap at the center and the circling stragglers.

subject.zh: 直径约 1 米的一团野蜂群，二三十只拇指大的蜂聚成蓬松的球；蜂身琥珀黄 #C8962A 与黑褐 #3A2A18 相间，翅膀是浅灰小块；团心裹着一小片蜂巢碎块 #D8B860；以整团扑上叮刺；辨识：外缘总有几只离群打转，整团像一朵起伏的云。

subject.zh: 体长约 1.1 米的瘦豺，四足细长，肋骨隐约可见；短毛灰黄 #9A8A6A，背上覆着灰烬色斑块 #8A8580，蓬尾尖端黑；眼白发灰；以细长的吻咬扯；辨识：一对大而尖的耳朵，侧腹一块门形秃斑露出灰色的皮。
subject.en: A lean jackal about 1.1 m long on long thin legs, ribs faintly showing; short sandy-gray fur #9A8A6A with ash-colored blotches #8A8580 on the back, a bushy black-tipped tail; grayish whites of the eyes; bites and tears with a narrow muzzle; identifying marks: a pair of large pointed ears, a door-shaped bald patch on its flank showing gray skin.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：大尖耳与侧腹的门形秃斑。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the large pointed ears and the door-shaped bald patch on the flank.

subject.zh: 翼展约 2.4 米的大秃鹫，光秃的长颈与头皮灰粉 #C8A898，颈根一圈蓬松白领羽；体羽暗褐 #4A3A2C，飞羽边缘发灰；钩喙粗大淡黄 #D8C890；以钩喙俯冲啄撕；辨识：秃头配白领羽，宽大的翼尖像张开的手指。
subject.en: A great vulture with a wingspan of about 2.4 m, a bare long neck and scalp in grayish pink #C8A898 and a fluffy white ruff at the base of the neck; dark brown body feathers #4A3A2C, flight feathers fading to gray at the edges; a heavy pale yellow hooked beak #D8C890; dives to peck and tear with the hooked beak; identifying marks: a bald head with a white ruff, broad wingtips spread like fingers.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：秃头、白领羽与钩喙。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the bald head, white ruff and hooked beak.

subject.zh: 体长约 0.6 米的扁圆大虱，六条短而带钩的节腿；灰白甲壳 #B8B4AC 一节节叠起，腹中透出几粒灰晶 #8A8580 的影子，甲缘泛淡紫 #C6B5E0；以口器刺吸、钩足抓附；辨识：背甲中线一排小晶刺，身体扁得几乎贴地。
subject.en: A flat, oval giant louse about 0.6 m long with six short hooked jointed legs; gray-white shell #B8B4AC in overlapping segments, the shadows of a few gray crystals #8A8580 showing through the belly, shell edges tinged pale lavender #C6B5E0; pierces and sucks with its mouthparts and clings with hooked feet; identifying marks: a row of small crystal spikes along the back's midline, a body so flat it nearly hugs the ground.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：背甲中线的小晶刺。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the crystal spikes along the back.

subject.zh: 高约 2 米、细长的人形灰影，没有五官，双腿融进一团翻卷的灰尘里；身体是层层叠叠的灰烬色 #8A8580 与暗灰 #4D4A52 薄片，像随风剥落的灰；胸口一个门形空洞；以长臂横扫、扬灰致盲；辨识：比常人高瘦，总是微微前倾，像在找路。
subject.en: A tall, thin humanoid shade about 2 m high with no features, its legs melting into a churning cloud of dust; its body is layered flakes of ash gray #8A8580 and dark gray #4D4A52, like ash peeling in the wind; a door-shaped hole in its chest; sweeps with long arms and flings blinding ash; identifying marks: taller and thinner than a person, always leaning slightly forward as if looking for the way.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：胸口的门形空洞与无五官的头。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the door-shaped hole in the chest and the featureless head.

subject.zh: 长约 0.8 米的肥白蛆虫，没有腿，身体一节节鼓胀；乳白表皮 #E0D8C8 下透出吞进去的澱晶，呈一串淡蓝 #9DB4C8 与淡紫 #C6B5E0 的亮块；头端一对小钳状口器；以口器啃咬，临死时体内晶块迸裂；辨识：身体中段的晶块最亮，像一串灯。
subject.en: A fat white grub about 0.8 m long, no legs, its body swelling segment by segment; swallowed crystals show through its milky skin #E0D8C8 as a string of bright pale blue #9DB4C8 and pale lavender #C6B5E0 lumps; a pair of small pincer mouthparts at the head; bites with its mouthparts and its crystals burst when it dies; identifying mark: the crystals in its middle are brightest, like a string of lamps.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：体内一串发亮的晶块。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the string of bright crystals inside its body.

subject.zh: 体长约 0.4 米的小褐鼠，四足、长尾；毛色土褐 #6B4F1D，颊囊鼓鼓地塞满铜钱，嘴角露出一枚金褐色钱币的边 #C9A227；两耳各有一个钱孔似的圆斑；以门齿咬、偷了钱就飞跑；辨识：鼓起的颊囊与嘴边那枚钱，个头比澱鼠小一圈。
subject.en: A small brown rat about 0.4 m long, four legs and a long tail; earth-brown fur #6B4F1D, cheek pouches stuffed with copper coins, the gold-brown rim of a coin #C9A227 showing at the corner of its mouth; a round coin-hole spot on each ear; bites with its incisors and dashes off after stealing; identifying marks: the bulging cheek pouches and the coin at its mouth, a size smaller than a sediment rat.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：鼓起的颊囊与嘴边的铜钱。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the bulging cheek pouches and the coin at its mouth.

subject.zh: 体长约 1.2 米的老母鼠，四足，坐着时像个驼背老妇；灰褐毛 #6B5A48 夹着大片秃斑，胡须长而发白；颈上挂着一串用细绳穿起的铜钱 #C9A227，尾巴盘起；以门齿咬、尾巴抽打；辨识：一只眼蒙着白翳，前爪一下下拨弄钱串，像在算账。
subject.en: An old mother rat about 1.2 m long on four legs, hunched like an old woman when sitting; gray-brown fur #6B5A48 with large bald patches, long whitened whiskers; a string of copper coins #C9A227 threaded on cord around her neck, tail coiled; bites with her incisors and lashes with her tail; identifying marks: one eye clouded white, her forepaws fingering the coin string as if keeping accounts.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：白翳的眼与颈上的钱串。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the clouded eye and the coin string at her neck.

subject.zh: 体长约 3 米的巨型母鼠，四足短粗，肿胀的腹部拖地；灰褐毛 #6B6359 结成一绺绺，背上大片暗灰斑 #4A443D 缠着谷壳与稻草；腹侧攀着几只小鼠；以巨大门齿啃咬、甩尾横扫；辨识：一对发黄的长门齿与秃尾，眼白全灰。
subject.en: A giant mother rat about 3 m long on short thick legs, her swollen belly dragging on the ground; gray-brown fur #6B6359 matted in clumps, large dark gray blotches #4A443D on the back tangled with chaff and straw; a few young rats clinging to her flanks; gnaws with huge incisors and sweeps with her tail; identifying marks: a pair of long yellowed incisors and a bald tail, eye-whites gone completely gray.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：发黄的长门齿与全灰的眼白。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the long yellowed incisors and the gray eye-whites.

subject.zh: 体长约 3 米的巨型锈甲虫，六条粗壮节腿，肥大的腹部拖着卵囊；鞘翅是厚重的锈铁板 #8A4A2A 与铁褐 #5A3A28，铆钉似的圆凸连成行，缝隙里锈粉簌簌落下；钳形大颚 #3A2A20；以大颚夹碎、喷锈雾；辨识：背甲中央一道焊缝似的隆脊，腹下挂着几颗灰白卵。
subject.en: A giant rust beetle about 3 m long with six thick jointed legs and a bloated abdomen dragging an egg sac; heavy rusted-iron wing cases #8A4A2A and iron brown #5A3A28, rows of rivet-like bumps, rust powder trickling from the seams; pincer mandibles #3A2A20; crushes with its mandibles and sprays rust mist; identifying marks: a weld-seam ridge down the middle of its back, a few gray-white eggs hanging under the abdomen.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：焊缝似的背脊隆起与钳形大颚。

subject.zh: 体长约 3 米的巨型锈甲虫，六条粗壮节腿，肥大的腹部拖着卵囊；鞘翅是厚重的锈铁板 #8A4A2A 与铁褐 #5A3A28，铆钉似的圆凸连成行，缝隙里锈粉簌簌落下；钳形大颚 #3A2A20；以大颚夹碎、喷锈雾；辨识：背甲中央一道焊缝似的隆脊，腹下挂着几颗灰白卵。

subject.zh: 比灰毛狼大一圈、体长约 1.8 米的独狼，四足；暗灰褐毛 #6E6A63，背脊深灰 #47443F，背上散着灰斑；左耳从中间裂成两瓣，裂口结着暗红旧疤 #B33A2A；一条前腿有一圈兽夹留下的秃痕；以獠牙扑咬撕扯；辨识：裂成两瓣的左耳与腿上的夹痕。
subject.en: A lone wolf a size bigger than a gray wolf, about 1.8 m long, four legs; dark gray-brown fur #6E6A63, darker gray spine #47443F, gray blotches across the back; its left ear split down the middle into two flaps with a dark red old scar #B33A2A along the tear; a ring of bald scarring from a trap on one foreleg; lunges, bites and tears with its fangs; identifying marks: the split left ear and the trap scar on the leg.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：裂成两瓣的左耳与暗红旧疤。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the split left ear and its dark red scar.

subject.zh: 人立高约 3.4 米、肩高约 1.8 米的巨熊，四足；全身深棕 #3D3833，后颈到尾根一道烧焦般的黑脊毛 #1F1D1B，毛尖焦卷；肩背的毛里散着灰斑 #7A6F64，眼白发灰；人立以巨掌横拍、扑咬；辨识：背上那道焦黑卷曲的长毛带，左肩三道旧爪疤。
subject.en: A huge bear about 3.4 m tall when rearing and 1.8 m at the shoulder, four legs; deep brown all over #3D3833 with a scorched-looking black ridge of fur #1F1D1B from the nape to the base of the tail, its tips singed and curled; gray blotches #7A6F64 scattered through the shoulder fur, gray eye-whites; rears to sweep with huge paws and bites; identifying marks: the scorched, curled black stripe down its spine, three old claw scars on its left shoulder.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：背脊焦黑卷曲的长毛带。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the scorched, curled black stripe along the spine.

subject.zh: 体长约 1.7 米的灰猪，四足短粗；黑褐鬃毛 #4A3A2C 里夹满灰鬃 #8A8580，背上灰斑成片；右獠牙上挂着一只褪色的小红袜子 #B04A3A，被泥土染得发暗；以低头冲撞、獠牙挑刺；辨识：獠牙上的红袜子，右耳缺了一角。
subject.en: A gray boar about 1.7 m long on short thick legs; black-brown bristles #4A3A2C full of gray bristles #8A8580, gray blotches spreading across its back; a faded little red sock #B04A3A hangs from its right tusk, darkened by mud; charges head down and gores with its tusks; identifying marks: the red sock on its tusk, a notch missing from its right ear.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：挂在右獠牙上的褪色红袜子。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the faded red sock on its right tusk.

subject.zh: 身高约 1.8 米的亡灵哨兵，两足直立；焦黑干皮 #3A2A24 包着骨，穿烧焦的旧皮甲与铁盔 #5A5A58；背上用铁链绑着一口裂开的青铜村钟 #7A6A3A，钟舌已失；胸口刀伤渗着暗红 #B33A2A；以钟链抡砸、震钟发声；辨识：背上那口裂钟与垂下的断链。
subject.en: An undead sentry about 1.8 m tall, standing on two legs; scorched dry hide #3A2A24 over bone, burnt old leather armor and an iron helm #5A5A58; a cracked bronze village bell #7A6A3A lashed to its back with iron chains, its clapper gone; a chest wound seeping dark red #B33A2A; swings the bell chain to smash and rings the bell to stun; identifying marks: the cracked bell on its back and the broken chain hanging from it.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：背上的裂口青铜钟与断链。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the cracked bronze bell and broken chain on its back.

subject.zh: 体长约 1.6 米的老锈甲虫，六条粗节腿，比同类大一倍；鞘翅厚如铁锅，锈红 #8A4A2A 上嵌着啃剩的铁钉与车铁碎片 #6A6A68；腹部鼓胀下垂，砂囊处透出铁灰硬块；以大颚咬碎、伏地突袭；辨识：鞘翅上扎着几根弯铁钉，大颚缺了一角。
subject.en: An old rust beetle about 1.6 m long with six thick jointed legs, twice the size of its kind; wing cases as thick as iron pots, rust red #8A4A2A studded with gnawed nails and scraps of cart iron #6A6A68; a swollen, sagging belly with iron-gray lumps showing at the gizzard; crunches with its mandibles and ambushes from below; identifying marks: a few bent nails stuck in its wing cases, a chipped mandible.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：扎着弯铁钉的鞘翅与缺角的大颚。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the nail-studded wing cases and the chipped mandible.

subject.zh: 体长约 1.3 米的豺群头领，四足细长，比同群高一头；灰黄毛 #9A8A6A 盖着灰烬斑 #8A8580，侧腹的门形秃斑更大；颈上套着一只旧皮项圈，挂一枚磨亮的铜牌 #B08A4A；以吻咬扯、叼走行囊；辨识：项圈与铜牌，嘴里常叼着一条肉干。
subject.en: A jackal pack leader about 1.3 m long on long thin legs, a head taller than the rest; sandy-gray fur #9A8A6A covered with ash blotches #8A8580, a larger door-shaped bald patch on its flank; an old leather collar with a polished brass tag #B08A4A round its neck; bites, tears and snatches packs; identifying marks: the collar and brass tag, a strip of jerky often in its mouth.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：旧皮项圈与磨亮的铜牌。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the old leather collar and polished brass tag.

subject.en: An old crystal louse about 1.5 m long, as big as a dog, with six thick hooked jointed legs; thick, cracked gray-white shell #B8B4AC, its back spikes grown into a row of fist-sized gray crystals #8A8580, a bulging belly showing the outline of one big crystal inside, shell edges pale lavender #C6B5E0; pierces and sucks with its mouthparts and rams with its crystal spikes; identifying mark: the big crystal in its swollen belly.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：背上一排拳头大的灰晶。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the row of fist-sized gray crystals on its back.

subject.zh: 肩高约 2 米的驼鹿，四条长腿、前高后低；粗长的暗褐毛 #4A3A2C，腿下部灰白 #B8B0A0，喉下垂着一绺肉垂；头顶一对宽大的掌状角 #C8B08A；以掌角横扫、前蹄踏击；辨识：掌状大角、隆起的肩峰与下垂的长鼻，干净的野生毛色。
subject.en: A moose about 2 m at the shoulder on four long legs, high in front and low behind; long coarse dark brown fur #4A3A2C, gray-white lower legs #B8B0A0, a dewlap hanging under the throat; a pair of broad palmate antlers #C8B08A; sweeps with its antlers and strikes with its forehooves; identifying marks: the palmate antlers, the raised shoulder hump and the drooping long nose, clean wild coloring.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：掌状大角与下垂的长鼻。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the palmate antlers and the drooping long nose.

subject.zh: 人立高约 2.8 米的熊，四足；毛色灰黑 #4A4644，背上一片灰白长毛 #A8A49C，灰毛中冒出一排赤黑角突 #5A1A16，像脊背上长出的短角；身上几道旧伤口张着渗红 #B33A2A；以前掌重拍、扑咬，越伤越凶；辨识：灰白背毛与脊上一排角突。
subject.en: A bear about 2.8 m tall when rearing, four legs; gray-black fur #4A4644 with a saddle of long gray-white fur #A8A49C on the back, a row of red-black horn knobs #5A1A16 jutting through it like short horns growing from the spine; a few old wounds gape and seep red #B33A2A; smashes with its forepaws and bites, growing fiercer when hurt; identifying marks: the gray-white back and the row of horn knobs along the spine.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：灰白背毛中的一排赤黑角突。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the row of red-black horn knobs in the gray-white back fur.

subject.zh: 体长约 0.4 米的白鼠，四足、长尾；短毛贴身，瓷白色 #EDE8DC，左右花纹完全对称，背脊一道淡金细线 #D8C27A；双眼是光滑的瓷珠，泛淡蓝 #9DB4C8；以门齿咬，被咬处结出细小白晶；辨识：瓷珠般的眼睛与过分整齐的对称体态。
subject.en: A white rat about 0.4 m long, four legs and a long tail; short sleek fur in porcelain white #EDE8DC with perfectly symmetrical markings, a thin pale gold line #D8C27A down the spine; eyes like smooth porcelain beads tinged pale blue #9DB4C8; bites with its incisors, leaving tiny white crystals where it bites; identifying marks: the porcelain-bead eyes and an unnaturally neat, symmetrical build.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：瓷珠般的眼睛与对称的花纹。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the porcelain-bead eyes and the symmetrical markings.

items.notes: 先做本条：主审通过后它是本主体全部动作表的参照图。瓷白不是纯白，用 #EDE8DC；左右必须对称，这是它和澱鼠的区别。

subject.zh: 高约 0.6 米的一摊灰白黏泥，没有骨骼与四肢，贴地缓慢蠕动；表面像冷却的油脂 #B9B4A8，夹着暗灰沉渣 #6E6A62 与几片烧尽的灰色晶壳；以泥身裹缠、腐蚀攻击；辨识：顶上总鼓着一个油亮的泡，形状松散，没有任何花纹与个性。
subject.en: A puddle of gray-white sticky ooze about 0.6 m tall, no skeleton or limbs, creeping slowly along the ground; its surface looks like cooled grease #B9B4A8 with dark gray dregs #6E6A62 and a few burnt-out gray crystal husks; attacks by engulfing and corroding; identifying marks: a glossy bubble always swelling on top, a loose shape with no pattern and no character at all.

subject.zh: 直径约 1 米的一团飞蛾群，几十只指甲大的蛾子聚成翻涌的团；蛾翅枯麦黄 #C9C1A0，翅缘长着橄榄绿霉斑 #6B7F3A，身体暗褐 #4A3B2A；团里夹着几根被啃断的麦穗；以整团扑面、撒落病粉；辨识：团下总飘着一层细细的黄绿粉尘。
subject.en: A swarm of moths about 1 m across, dozens of fingernail-sized moths gathered into a churning cluster; wings of dry wheat yellow #C9C1A0 with olive-green mildew spots #6B7F3A at the edges, dark brown bodies #4A3B2A; a few gnawed-off wheat ears caught in the cluster; attacks by swarming into faces and dusting sickly powder; identifying mark: a thin haze of yellow-green dust always drifting beneath it.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：瓷白安详的脸与淌血的伤口。

subject.zh: 高约 1 米的一团腐泥，没有骨骼与四肢，下沉上鼓；泥身暗橄榄绿 #4F5A34，表面浮着浅绿泡沫 #8C9A5C，深处夹着几块整齐的瓷白方形晶片 #EDE8DC；以扑压与喷溅腐泥攻击；辨识：泥里的晶片左右对称排成两列，顶上不停冒泡。
subject.en: A blob of foul sludge about 1 m tall, no skeleton or limbs, sagging at the base and swelling on top; dark olive-green mud #4F5A34 with pale green froth #8C9A5C on the surface and a few neat square porcelain-white crystal chips #EDE8DC deep inside; attacks by flopping and spraying sludge; identifying marks: the chips lined up symmetrically in two columns, bubbles constantly rising on top.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：泥里对称排列的瓷白晶片。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the symmetrical porcelain-white chips inside the sludge.

subject.zh: 身高约 1.7 米的溺死者，两足拖行；皮肉泡得发胀，青灰 #5A6B6E，湿发贴脸，穿滴水的旧粗布衣 #34403F；脸部却像瓷器一样平滑安详 #EDE8DC，双眼是光滑的白瓷珠；以湿冷的手掐抓、拖人下水；辨识：腰上缠着一段断缆绳，衣角不停滴水。
subject.en: A drowned corpse about 1.7 m tall dragging itself on two legs; bloated, blue-gray waterlogged flesh #5A6B6E, wet hair plastered to its head, dripping old coarse clothes #34403F; yet its face is smooth and serene like porcelain #EDE8DC, with eyes of polished white porcelain beads; strangles with cold wet hands and drags victims under; identifying marks: a length of broken mooring rope round its waist, water dripping constantly from its hems.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：瓷器般平滑的脸与白瓷珠眼。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the porcelain-smooth face and white porcelain eyes.

subject.zh: 长约 1.5 米的巨型水蛭，没有腿，身体扁而有环纹、能伸缩；背面暗紫褐 #3B2A2E，两侧各一道锈红纵纹 #7A4A52，腹面略浅；两端各一个吸盘，前吸盘里一圈细齿；以吸盘吸附、细齿咬吸；辨识：吸饱时身体鼓成纺锤，背上透出澱紫暗斑 #4A3A62。
subject.en: A giant leech about 1.5 m long, no legs, its flat ringed body able to stretch and contract; dark purplish-brown back #3B2A2E with a rust-red stripe #7A4A52 along each side, a slightly paler belly; a sucker at each end, the front one ringed with fine teeth; latches on with its suckers and bites and drinks; identifying marks: it swells into a spindle when gorged, with sediment-violet patches #4A3A62 showing on its back.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：前吸盘里的一圈细齿。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the ring of fine teeth in the front sucker.

subject.zh: 高约 1.7 米的书灵，下半身是一层层焦黄书页卷成的裙摆，没有腿，悬空飘行；上身是穿旧长袍的消瘦人形，皮色焦褐 #8A7A5A，袍暗褐 #4F4533；怀里抱着一本烧焦的厚书，页缘羊皮纸色 #E8D9B0；以翻飞的焦页割伤、抽吸灵力；辨识：书页上浮着看不清的划痕纹。
subject.en: A book wraith about 1.7 m tall whose lower body is a skirt of scorched yellow pages rolled layer on layer, no legs, drifting in the air; its upper body is a gaunt figure in an old robe, scorched brown skin #8A7A5A, dark brown robe #4F4533; it hugs a thick burnt book whose page edges are parchment colored #E8D9B0; cuts with fluttering burnt pages and drains spirit; identifying mark: unreadable scratch marks floating on its pages.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：怀抱的焦书与书页裙摆。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the burnt book in its arms and the skirt of pages.

subject.zh: 长约 1.8 米的蜈蚣，约二十节身体、每节一对节腿；甲壳暗灰蓝 #4A5866，节缝深一级 #2B333C，每节背甲竖着一枚浅冰蓝晶刺 #A8C4DC；头部一对弯钳毒颚；以毒颚咬、晶刺撞；辨识：背上的晶刺从头到尾由小到大排列，长须向后掠。
subject.en: A centipede about 1.8 m long with about twenty body segments and a pair of jointed legs on each; dark gray-blue shell #4A5866, seams one step darker #2B333C, a pale ice-blue crystal spike #A8C4DC standing on each back plate; a pair of curved venom pincers at the head; bites with its venom pincers and rams with its spikes; identifying marks: the crystal spikes grow larger from head to tail, long feelers swept back.

subject.zh: 身高约 1.6 米的食尸鬼，常四肢着地爬行，起身时佝偻；灰白干皮 #B8B0A4 紧贴骨头，背上灰烬色斑 #6B6660，指爪细长发黑 #3F3B37；下颌像脱了臼一样张大，满口碎牙；以长爪抓撕、扑咬；辨识：腹侧一个门形空洞，透过它看得见肋骨。
subject.en: A ghoul about 1.6 m tall that usually crawls on all fours and hunches when it rises; gray-white dry skin #B8B0A4 stretched over bone, ash-colored blotches #6B6660 on the back, long thin blackened claws #3F3B37; its lower jaw hangs open as if dislocated, full of broken teeth; tears with long claws and lunges to bite; identifying mark: a door-shaped hole in its flank through which its ribs show.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：张大的下颌与腹侧的门形空洞。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the gaping jaw and the door-shaped hole in its flank.

subject.zh: 高约 2.8 米的灰烬巨形，粗短的双腿与一对过长的手臂，没有颈；全身是不断剥落又聚拢的灰烬块 #5A5652 与焦黑碎石 #34312E，缝隙里透出暗红余烬与淡紫微光 #C6B5E0；以重臂砸地、喷灰攻击；辨识：头部只是一团灰，正中一道门形裂口。
subject.en: A hulking ash form about 2.8 m tall with short thick legs, overlong arms and no neck; its whole body is ash clods #5A5652 and charred rubble #34312E that keep flaking off and drawing back together, dull red embers and pale lavender glints #C6B5E0 showing through the cracks; slams the ground with its heavy arms and spews ash; identifying mark: its head is only a lump of ash with a door-shaped split in the middle.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：灰团头部正中的门形裂口。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the door-shaped split in its ash-lump head.

subject.zh: 身高约 2 米的亡灵骑士，两足直立；穿千年前式样的板甲，甲面蒙着厚灰 #4A4744，接缝发黑 #2B2927，门形面甲后只有一团余烬红光 #C84A2A；持长剑与残破圆盾 #9A948C；以重剑劈砍、盾撞；辨识：披风烧成一条条灰布，胸甲纹章被磨平。
subject.en: An undead knight about 2 m tall standing on two legs; plate armor of a style a thousand years old, its surface caked with thick ash #4A4744 and blackened at the joints #2B2927, nothing behind its door-shaped visor but a glow of ember red #C84A2A; carries a longsword and a battered round shield #9A948C; hews with the sword and bashes with the shield; identifying marks: a cloak burnt into strips of ash cloth, the crest on its breastplate worn smooth.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：门形面甲后的余烬红光。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the ember glow behind the door-shaped visor.

subject.zh: 站高约 3.2 米的亚龙，后腿双足站立，前肢化为残破膜翼，长颈长尾；鳞片赤褐 #5A2E24 而黯淡，覆着一层灰 #8A8580，鳞缝透出橙红 #C8784A；胸口嵌着一片发灰的旧龙蜕，像补丁；以利齿扑咬、甩尾、喷灰火；辨识：翼膜上满是门形的破洞。
subject.en: A drake about 3.2 m tall standing on its hind legs, forelimbs turned into tattered membrane wings, long neck and long tail; dull red-brown scales #5A2E24 under a coat of ash #8A8580, orange-red #C8784A glowing between the scales; a grayed old dragon slough set into its chest like a patch; bites, lashes its tail and breathes ashen fire; identifying mark: wing membranes full of door-shaped holes.

subject.zh: 身高约 1.9 米的人形澱兵，两足直立；全身是浓黑的澱 #1C1C22，边缘像墨在水里化开，胸背与手臂上浮着许多大小不一的灰白人脸 #5A5A6A，表情各不相同；握着一柄澱凝成的长矛；以长矛刺、扑抱；辨识：头部没有自己的脸，只有一圈别人的脸围着空处。
subject.en: A humanoid sediment soldier about 1.9 m tall on two legs; its whole body is thick black sediment #1C1C22 whose edges bleed like ink in water, with many gray-white human faces #5A5A6A of different sizes and expressions surfacing across its chest, back and arms; it holds a spear congealed from sediment; stabs with the spear and grapples; identifying mark: its head has no face of its own, only a ring of other faces around an empty space.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：头部围成一圈的他人面孔。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the ring of other people's faces around its empty head.

subject.zh: 身长约 1.8 米的螳螂，六条细节腿，最前一对化为锯齿镰臂；身体像石化的枯枝，灰褐 #6E665A，节上带树皮纹与灰斑 #8A8580，三角头上一对灰白复眼；以镰臂勾割；辨识：静止时双镰并拢、身体僵直，整只像一截折断的焦枝。
subject.en: A mantis about 1.8 m long on six thin jointed legs, the front pair turned into serrated scythe arms; its body looks like a petrified dead branch, gray-brown #6E665A with bark texture and ash blotches #8A8580 on the joints, a pair of gray-white compound eyes on its triangular head; hooks and slices with its scythe arms; identifying mark: when still it folds its scythes and goes rigid, looking exactly like a broken charred branch.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：锯齿镰臂与三角头。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the serrated scythe arms and the triangular head.

subject.zh: 身高约 1.7 米的骸骨兵，两足直立；骨色灰黄 #C8BFA8，关节积灰，眼窝一点暗红 #B33A2A；身上挂着不同年代的残甲，一侧是锈鳞甲，一侧是皮护肩 #6A5A48；手持缺口的旧式兵器；以兵器劈砍；辨识：甲与兵器明显来自不同时代，肋间插着一支断箭。
subject.en: A skeleton soldier about 1.7 m tall on two legs; grayish-yellow bones #C8BFA8 with ash in the joints, a dark red spark #B33A2A in each eye socket; scraps of armor from different eras hang on it, rusted scale on one side and a leather pauldron #6A5A48 on the other; carries a notched old weapon; hacks with its weapon; identifying marks: armor and weapon clearly from different ages, a broken arrow lodged between its ribs.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：不同年代的残甲与肋间断箭。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the mismatched armor scraps and the arrow in its ribs.

subject.zh: 体长约 1.4 米的犬形骸骨，四足；骨架灰白 #C8C0B0，残留的皮毛像干枯灰絮 #8A8580 挂在肋间；眼窝两点淡紫微光 #C6B5E0；颈上还挂着一只发绿的旧铜项圈 #6A8A6A；以骨颚撕咬、成群扑击；辨识：铜项圈与空荡荡的胸腔。

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：发绿的铜项圈与空胸腔。

subject.zh: 身高约 1.6 米的亡灵，两足拖行；全身像被灰烬糊住的人形 #8A8580，看得出生前的轮廓，穿千年前式样的家常衣裳与围裙 #6A6258；怀里抱着一件家什（锅、篮或布包）；以灰手抓扑、吸走生气；辨识：灰壳下只剩模糊的五官，胸口一个门形空洞。
subject.en: An undead about 1.6 m tall shuffling on two legs; its whole body looks like a person plastered in ash #8A8580, the living shape still visible, wearing everyday clothes and an apron #6A6258 of a style a thousand years old; it clutches a household thing (a pot, a basket or a cloth bundle); grabs with ashen hands and drains vitality; identifying marks: only blurred features left under the ash crust, a door-shaped hole in its chest.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：灰壳下模糊的五官与怀里的家什。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the blurred features under the ash and the household item in its arms.

extra.zh: 整张图的所有帧都面向镜头（朝下）。
extra.en: Every frame in this sheet faces the viewer (down).

subject.zh: 高约 3 米的骨堆巨形，四条粗腿由大腿骨捆成，躯干是无数肋骨与头骨叠成的笼；骨色深浅不一，从新白 #D8D0BC 到焦黑 #3A3632，各个年代的骨混在一起；以骨爪踏碾、吸附骨堆回补；辨识：胸笼里滚动着一圈头骨，背上插着几根折断的旧枪杆。
subject.en: A huge bone-heap creature about 3 m tall, its four thick legs bundled from thighbones, its trunk a cage of countless ribs and skulls; the bones range from fresh white #D8D0BC to charred black #3A3632, bones of many ages mixed together; tramples with bony claws and pulls in bone piles to mend itself; identifying marks: a ring of skulls rolling inside its chest cage, a few broken old spear shafts stuck in its back.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：胸笼里滚动的一圈头骨。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the ring of skulls rolling in its chest cage.

items.notes: 先做本条：主审通过后它是本主体全部动作表的参照图。天生精英；骨缝间透出背景色。

subject.zh: 高约 2.2 米、勉强像人的一团灰澱，两条粗腿、没有手指的长臂；身体是不断鼓起又塌陷的灰黑澱块 #4D4A52，表面浮现又消失着模糊的人脸与手印 #8A8580，裂缝透出淡紫光 #C6B5E0；以身体脉冲震荡、拖慢敌人；辨识：头部是一团起伏的灰，身侧总有半张人脸。
subject.en: A barely human mass of gray sediment about 2.2 m tall, with two thick legs and long fingerless arms; its body is gray-black sediment #4D4A52 that keeps bulging and sagging, blurred faces and handprints #8A8580 surfacing and fading on it, pale lavender light #C6B5E0 showing through its cracks; sends out pulses that shake and slow its foes; identifying marks: its head is a heaving lump of ash, and half a face always shows on its side.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：身侧浮出的半张人脸。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the half face surfacing on its side.

subject.zh: 高约 3 米的晶石魔像，两足站立，像一根活过来的门柱；躯干由灰紫色澱晶簇 #8A80A0 与玻璃化的黑石 #34313A 堆成，晶面平整、反着淡紫光 #C6B5E0；双臂是两束粗晶柱；以晶臂砸击、晶面反弹法术；辨识：站姿笔直对称，头顶平直，像门框的立柱。
subject.en: A crystal golem about 3 m tall standing on two legs, like a door pillar come to life; its trunk is piled from gray-violet sediment crystal clusters #8A80A0 and vitrified black stone #34313A, flat crystal faces gleaming pale lavender #C6B5E0; its arms are two thick bundles of crystal columns; smashes with its crystal arms and turns spells off its facets; identifying marks: a straight, symmetrical stance and a flat top, like the upright of a door frame.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：平整的晶面与门柱般的站姿。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the flat crystal facets and the door-pillar stance.

items.notes: 先做本条：主审通过后它是本主体全部动作表的参照图。要用钝器才打得碎：倒地帧画成晶柱断裂。

subject.zh: 高约 3.2 米的石质守卫，两足站立；躯体是风化灰石 #8A8580 雕成的武士形，石面布满裂纹与灰斑 #4D4A52，胸口一个门形空洞；左臂残缺，右手握一根石戟；以石戟横扫、冲撞；辨识：石盔面甲只有一道横缝，缝里透着淡紫光 #C6B5E0。
subject.en: A stone guardian about 3.2 m tall standing on two legs; its body is a warrior figure carved from weathered gray stone #8A8580, covered in cracks and dark blotches #4D4A52, a door-shaped hole in its chest; its left arm is broken off and its right hand grips a stone halberd; sweeps with the halberd and charges; identifying mark: its stone visor is a single horizontal slit with pale lavender light #C6B5E0 inside.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：石盔面甲的横缝与胸口门形空洞。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the visor slit and the door-shaped hole in its chest.

extra.zh: 整张图的所有帧都朝画面右方（侧面）。
extra.en: Every frame in this sheet faces screen right (side view).

subject.zh: 身高约 1.7 米的亡灵，两足直立；干枯灰皮 #8A8580 包着骨，穿锈蚀的旧式鳞甲，罩着褪色白罩袍 #D8D2C0，胸前缝着一枚十字形圣印；肩扛铁铲与铁镐 #5A5A58；以铲镐劈砸；辨识：它总在挖，指节磨穿露骨，罩袍下摆沾满灰土。
subject.en: An undead about 1.7 m tall on two legs; dry gray hide #8A8580 over bone, rusted old-style scale armor under a faded white surcoat #D8D2C0 with a cross-shaped holy seal sewn on the chest; it shoulders a shovel and a pick #5A5A58; hacks and smashes with them; identifying marks: it is always digging, knuckles worn through to the bone, the surcoat hem caked with ash and dirt.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：胸前的十字形圣印与磨穿的指节。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the cross-shaped seal on its chest and the worn-through knuckles.

subject.zh: 身长约 1.6 米的蝎子，八条节腿、一对大钳、高翘的节尾带毒刺；甲壳是烟灰色玻璃 #6E6A72，甲里封着熔化的砂石与焦土纹 #4D4A52；钳与刺尖泛淡紫 #C6B5E0；以钳夹、尾刺毒蛰，甲面反光刺眼；辨识：玻璃甲里封着的焦土纹路。
subject.en: A scorpion about 1.6 m long with eight jointed legs, a pair of big pincers and a high-curled segmented tail with a venom sting; smoke-gray glass shell #6E6A72 with melted sand and scorched-earth streaks #4D4A52 sealed inside; pincers and sting tip tinged pale lavender #C6B5E0; pinches, stings with venom and dazzles with its glaring shell; identifying mark: the scorched-earth streaks sealed in its glass shell.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：玻璃甲里封着的焦土纹路。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the scorched-earth streaks sealed in its glass shell.

subject.zh: 长约 3 米的灰色巨蠕，没有腿，身体粗如水桶、满是皱褶的环节；表皮灰烬色 #8A8580，背上覆着一层板结的灰壳 #4D4A52，腹面浅灰；头端一张四瓣花苞般的口器，内壁一圈倒钩齿；以口器咬吞、翻身陷人；辨识：张开时四瓣口像花开。
subject.en: A giant gray worm about 3 m long, no legs, a body as thick as a barrel with wrinkled segments; ash-colored skin #8A8580, a crust of caked ash #4D4A52 on its back, pale gray underside; a four-petaled bud-like mouth at the head, ringed inside with barbed teeth; bites, swallows and rolls to drag foes down; identifying mark: its four-petaled mouth opens like a flower.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：花苞般的四瓣口器与倒钩齿。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the four-petaled mouth and its barbed teeth.

subject.zh: 高约 1 米的一团淡紫冷火，没有身体；火焰烧成门框形，左右两股直立、顶上横连，外层淡紫 #C6B5E0、内层暗灰 #4D4A52，框中间是空的；火苗底部滴落灼热的灰烬；以扑身灼烧、炸开火星；辨识：火焰始终烧成一扇门的形状。
subject.en: A pale lavender cold flame about 1 m tall with no body; the fire burns in the shape of a door frame, two upright tongues joined by a lintel across the top, pale lavender #C6B5E0 outside and dark gray #4D4A52 inside, empty in the middle; hot ash drips from the base of the flames; attacks by lunging to scorch and bursting into sparks; identifying mark: the flame always burns in the shape of a door.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：烧成门框形的火焰。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the flame burning in a door-frame shape.

subject.zh: 身高约 2 米的空铠甲，两足走动；千年前式样的板甲蒙着灰 #6A6660，甲片之间没有身体，缝隙里看得见背后；胸甲中央破出一个门形空洞；手持一柄宽刃长剑 #8A8A88；以重剑横劈；辨识：头盔里空空的，面甲缝里只有淡紫微光 #C6B5E0。
subject.en: An empty suit of armor about 2 m tall that walks on two legs; plate armor of a style a thousand years old, coated in ash #6A6660, with no body between the plates so you can see through the gaps; a door-shaped hole broken through the middle of its breastplate; it wields a broad-bladed longsword #8A8A88; cleaves with the heavy sword; identifying mark: the helmet is empty, with only a pale lavender glint #C6B5E0 in the visor slit.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：空空的头盔与胸甲上的门形空洞。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the empty helmet and the door-shaped hole in the breastplate.

extra.zh: 整张图的所有帧都面向镜头（朝下）。
extra.en: Every frame in this sheet faces the viewer (down).

subject.zh: 体长约 1.7 米的瘦狼，四足；毛皮灰烬色 #8A8580 薄得贴骨，背脊与尾巴焦黑 #4D4A52；腹部被掏空成一个门形大洞，洞里什么也没有；眼睛是两点淡紫光 #C6B5E0；以獠牙扑咬、寒气侵骨；辨识：腹部那个门形空洞，透过它能看到后面。
subject.en: A gaunt wolf about 1.7 m long, four legs; ash-colored fur #8A8580 so thin it clings to the bones, charred black spine and tail #4D4A52; its belly is hollowed out into a large door-shaped hole with nothing inside; two points of pale lavender light #C6B5E0 for eyes; lunges with its fangs and chills to the bone; identifying mark: the door-shaped hole through its belly, through which you can see what is behind it.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：腹部的门形空洞。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the door-shaped hole through its belly.

subject.zh: 身高约 1.6 米的亡灵老妇，两足、佝偻；全身覆着细灰 #8A8580，穿千年前式样的家常长裙与头巾 #7A6E62，系着围裙；一手提着空铁锅，一手握长柄木勺；以木勺敲打、吸走生气；辨识：她总在搅那口空锅，头巾下露出一缕灰白的发。
subject.en: An undead old woman about 1.6 m tall, stooped on two legs; covered all over in fine ash #8A8580, wearing an everyday long dress and headscarf #7A6E62 of a style a thousand years old, with an apron; an empty iron pot in one hand and a long wooden ladle in the other; strikes with the ladle and drains vitality; identifying marks: she keeps stirring the empty pot, a wisp of gray-white hair under her headscarf.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：空铁锅与长柄木勺。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the empty iron pot and the long ladle.

items.notes: 先做本条：主审通过后它是本主体全部动作表的参照图。Q 版人形比例；待机行画成搅锅。

subject.zh: 身高约 1.1 米的孩童亡灵，两足；全身是灰烬色的人形 #8A8580，穿千年前式样的短袍与小布鞋 #7A6E62；一只手总举在胸前，指节向前敲；脸看不清，只有一双淡紫的眼 #C6B5E0；被攻击才用小拳头反击；辨识：一直保持敲门的姿势，背上斜挎一块小石板。
subject.en: A child undead about 1.1 m tall on two legs; an ash-colored figure #8A8580 in a short tunic and small cloth shoes #7A6E62 of a style a thousand years old; one hand always raised before its chest, knuckles knocking forward; its face is unreadable except for a pair of pale lavender eyes #C6B5E0; only hits back with small fists when attacked; identifying marks: it always holds the knocking pose, a small slate slung across its back.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：举在胸前敲门的小手与背上的石板。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the small knocking hand and the slate on its back.

subject.zh: 体长约 2.2 米、前倾冲锋的灰澱兽形，四肢粗短，没有头，前端是一道楔形的灰浪边缘；身体是翻滚的灰黑澱 #2E2C34 与灰烬碎屑 #8A8580，背后拖着长长的灰烟；以楔形前缘冲撞、践踏；辨识：身后灰烟里浮着破碎的门框残片。
subject.en: A beast-like mass of gray sediment about 2.2 m long, leaning forward in a charge, with short thick limbs and no head, its front a wedge-shaped crest of an ash wave; its body is rolling gray-black sediment #2E2C34 and ash debris #8A8580, a long trail of gray smoke streaming behind; rams with its wedge front and tramples; identifying mark: broken door-frame fragments floating in the smoke behind it.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：楔形的灰浪前缘。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the wedge-shaped ash-wave front.

subject.zh: 身高约 1.7 米的亡灵石匠，两足、弓背；灰白干皮 #B8B0A4 贴骨，穿式样古旧的白色祭司长袍，袍边一圈褪色淡金纹 #D8C27A，外系皮围裙；一手凿子一手铁锤 #6A6A68；以锤凿砸击，凿声令人失声；辨识：始终重复举锤落凿的动作，袍上落满石粉。
subject.en: An undead stonemason about 1.7 m tall, stooped on two legs; gray-white dry hide #B8B0A4 over bone, an old-fashioned white priest's robe with a band of faded pale gold trim #D8C27A at the hem and a leather apron over it; a chisel in one hand and an iron hammer #6A6A68 in the other; strikes with hammer and chisel, and its chiselling strikes silence; identifying marks: it endlessly repeats raising the hammer and bringing it down on the chisel, its robe covered in stone dust.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：锤与凿，袍边的淡金纹。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the hammer and chisel and the pale gold trim of the robe.

subject.zh: 体长约 1.8 米的狼形澱影，四足；全身是浓黑的澱 #1C1A22，没有皮毛与骨，边缘像烟一样不断散开，一圈淡紫光 #C6B5E0 勾出狼的轮廓；眼与口只是三道光缝；以光缝之口扑咬、吸走生气；辨识：四爪末端散成烟缕，跑动时身形拉长。
subject.en: A wolf-shaped sediment shadow about 1.8 m long, four legs; its whole body is thick black sediment #1C1A22 with no fur or bone, edges constantly dispersing like smoke, a rim of pale lavender light #C6B5E0 tracing the wolf outline; its eyes and mouth are just three slits of light; lunges with its slit mouth and drains vitality; identifying marks: its four paws trail off into smoke, and its shape stretches out as it runs.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：三道光缝组成的眼与口。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the three slits of light for eyes and mouth.

subject.zh: 肩高约 0.8 米的山羊，四足矫健；长毛乳白 #E8E2D4，脊背一道浅灰 #B8B0A0，脸与腿下部带浅褐斑；一对向后弯的棱角 #A89A80，颌下一撮山羊须；以角顶撞、后蹄踢；辨识：后弯的棱角与长须，干净的野生毛色。
subject.en: A goat about 0.8 m at the shoulder, nimble on four legs; long creamy white coat #E8E2D4 with a pale gray stripe #B8B0A0 down the spine, light brown patches on the face and lower legs; a pair of ridged horns #A89A80 sweeping back, a tuft of beard under the jaw; butts with its horns and kicks with its hind legs; identifying marks: the back-swept ridged horns and the beard, clean wild coloring.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：后弯的棱角与山羊须。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the back-swept ridged horns and the beard.

subject.zh: 翼展约 0.6 米的鸽子，羽色瓷白 #EDE8DC，左右花纹完全对称；羽根已经瓷化，硬得像釉面，翼缘一道淡金 #D8C27A；眼是淡蓝 #9DB4C8 的瓷珠；以扑翼闪光晃眼、啄击；辨识：釉面般发亮的瓷化羽根与过分对称的身形。
subject.en: A dove with a wingspan of about 0.6 m, porcelain-white plumage #EDE8DC with perfectly symmetrical markings; the bases of its feathers have turned to porcelain, hard and glazed, with a pale gold edge #D8C27A along the wings; eyes of pale blue #9DB4C8 porcelain beads; dazzles with flashing wingbeats and pecks; identifying marks: glazed porcelain feather bases and an unnaturally symmetrical body.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：釉面般的瓷化羽根。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the glazed porcelain feather bases.

subject.en: A white dove with a wingspan of about 0.6 m, white plumage tinged pale gray #D8D4CC, two gray bars #8A8A8A on each wing, an iridescent green-violet band around the neck; pink feet and orange-red eyes; never attacks and flies off when startled; identifying marks: a thin strip of white cloth tied to one leg, soft natural feathers a little ruffled.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：脚上的白布条与颈侧虹彩。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the white cloth strip on its leg and the iridescent neck band.

subject.zh: 直径约 1 米的一团白蛆，几十条手指粗的蛆虫缠成一团蠕动；每条都是瓷白色 #EDE8DC、两头尖、节纹整齐，节缝泛淡金 #D8C27A，排列得出奇对称；团中央露出几片苍白碎骨 #C8C0B0；以整团扑上啃咬、传播病气；辨识：整团蛆左右对称地起伏。
subject.en: A writhing mass of white maggots about 1 m across, dozens of finger-thick grubs knotted together; each is porcelain white #EDE8DC, pointed at both ends, with neat segment lines tinged pale gold #D8C27A, the whole mass arranged with uncanny symmetry; a few pale bone fragments #C8C0B0 show in its middle; attacks by swarming and gnawing and spreads sickness; identifying mark: the mass heaves symmetrically left and right.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：蛆团中央的苍白碎骨。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the pale bone fragments in the middle of the mass.

subject.zh: 体长约 1.6 米的犬形澱生体，四足修长；全身像一件上釉的瓷器 #EDE8DC，裂纹里透出淡蓝光 #9DB4C8，关节处是淡金连接环 #D8C27A；头部光滑无毛，眼是两个空的瓷孔；以瓷牙扑咬、瓷面反弹法术；辨识：裂纹左右完全对称，碎裂处只掉瓷片、不流血。
subject.en: A dog-shaped sediment creature about 1.6 m long on long slender legs; its whole body looks like glazed porcelain #EDE8DC with pale blue light #9DB4C8 showing through its cracks, pale gold rings #D8C27A at the joints; a smooth hairless head with two empty porcelain holes for eyes; bites with porcelain teeth and turns spells off its glaze; identifying marks: cracks that are perfectly symmetrical, and wounds that only shed porcelain chips, never blood.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：对称的裂纹与空洞的瓷孔眼。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the symmetrical cracks and the empty porcelain eye holes.

subject.zh: 高约 1.8 米的游魂，下半身散成白雾，没有腿；身穿旧式白长袍 #E8E2D4，袍边淡金纹 #D8C27A；脸是一张安详完美、左右对称的圣徒面容，像瓷像 #EDE8DC，双目闭合；以冰冷的手掌抽取、为同伴回复；辨识：头上戴着一圈瓷质荆环，脸上的神情始终不变。
subject.en: A wandering spirit about 1.8 m tall whose lower body dissolves into white mist, no legs; it wears an old-style white robe #E8E2D4 with pale gold trim #D8C27A; its face is a serene, flawless, perfectly symmetrical saint's face, like a porcelain statue #EDE8DC, eyes closed; drains with cold palms and restores its allies; identifying marks: a circlet of porcelain thorns on its head, an expression that never changes.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：对称安详的瓷像面容与瓷质荆环。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the serene symmetrical porcelain face and the porcelain thorn circlet.

subject.zh: 身高约 1.6 米的老修士尸傀，两足、佝偻；干枯皮肉灰白 #C8C0B0，穿褪色的旧式灰褐修士袍 #6A5E50，腰间挂着念珠；嘴一直开合，脸上留着几块整齐的瓷白斑 #EDE8DC；以念珠抽打、诵念让人失语；辨识：双手合在胸前捧着一卷合拢的旧经卷。
subject.en: The animated corpse of an old monk about 1.6 m tall, stooped on two legs; withered gray-white flesh #C8C0B0, a faded old-style gray-brown monk's habit #6A5E50 with prayer beads at the belt; its mouth never stops moving, and a few neat porcelain-white patches #EDE8DC mark its face; lashes with its beads and chants foes into silence; identifying mark: its hands held together at its chest around a closed old scroll.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：合在胸前捧着的旧经卷。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the closed old scroll held at its chest.

subject.zh: 直径约 1.2 米的悬浮晶团，没有肢体；核心是一枚瓷白的多面晶 #EDE8DC，外面围着一圈对称的淡金晶刺 #D8C27A，像一顶冠冕；四周漂着几片淡蓝瓷屑 #9DB4C8；以光爆震荡、为身边的魔物回复；辨识：冠冕状的晶刺圈永远保持正对称。
subject.en: A floating crystal cluster about 1.2 m across with no limbs; its core is a porcelain-white faceted crystal #EDE8DC surrounded by a symmetrical ring of pale gold crystal spikes #D8C27A, like a crown; a few pale blue porcelain flakes #9DB4C8 drift around it; sends out bursts of light and restores nearby monsters; identifying mark: the crown of spikes is always perfectly symmetrical.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：冠冕状的淡金晶刺圈。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the crown-like ring of pale gold spikes.

subject.zh: 高约 3 米的瓷石守像，两足站立，像一座活过来的圣龛；躯干是一只巨大的白瓷骨匣 #EDE8DC，匣面交叉贴着淡金封条 #D8C27A，匣缝里露出苍白的骨；四臂对称，两臂托匣、两臂持瓷杖；以瓷杖砸击、封匣定身；辨识：胸前骨匣上交叉的封条。
subject.en: A porcelain-stone guardian about 3 m tall standing on two legs, like a shrine come to life; its trunk is a huge white porcelain reliquary box #EDE8DC with pale gold seal strips #D8C27A crossed over its face, pale bones showing through the seams; four symmetrical arms, two holding up the box and two wielding porcelain staves; smashes with its staves and seals foes in place; identifying mark: the crossed seal strips on the reliquary at its chest.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：骨匣上交叉的淡金封条。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the crossed pale gold seal strips on the reliquary.

subject.zh: 肩高约 1.4 米的矮壮野马，四足；毛色暗栗 #6A4A30，鬃毛与尾巴黑而蓬乱 #2A2220，腿下部发黑，吻部浅灰；冬毛厚长；受惊即逃，被逼时以后蹄踢；辨识：短粗的颈与乱蓬蓬遮住眼睛的额鬃，干净的野生毛色。
subject.en: A stocky wild horse about 1.4 m at the shoulder, four legs; dark chestnut coat #6A4A30, black shaggy mane and tail #2A2220, darker lower legs, pale gray muzzle; a thick long winter coat; flees when startled and kicks with its hind legs when cornered; identifying marks: a short thick neck and a shaggy forelock that hides its eyes, clean wild coloring.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：遮住眼睛的蓬乱额鬃。

subject.zh: 体长约 2 米的大蜥蜴，四足外撇、长尾；鳞片赤褐 #7A3A2A，背上一排黑色骨板 #1C1A1A，鼻端与眉骨长出三只赤黑短角 #5A1A16；身上几道旧伤口张着、渗出暗红 #B33A2A；以角冲撞、咬住甩头；辨识：鼻端三角与满身斗场留下的旧疤。
subject.en: A big lizard about 2 m long with sprawling legs and a long tail; red-brown scales #7A3A2A, a row of black bony plates #1C1A1A down its back, three short red-black horns #5A1A16 on its snout and brows; a few old wounds that gape and seep dark red #B33A2A; rams with its horns and bites and thrashes its head; identifying marks: the three horns on its snout and the old arena scars all over its body.

subject.zh: 体长约 1 米的大蟾蜍，四足蹲伏；疙瘩皮暗橄榄褐 #5A5238，满身铁灰色硬斑 #6A6A68，像生锈的铁钉头，斑缝渗着暗红 #B33A2A；喉囊鼓胀；以长舌卷吞、喷射毒液；辨识：背上的铁斑疙瘩与鼓起的大喉囊。
subject.en: A big toad about 1 m long squatting on four legs; warty dark olive-brown skin #5A5238 covered with hard iron-gray patches #6A6A68 like rusty nail heads, dark red #B33A2A seeping from the cracks; a swollen throat sac; snatches prey with its long tongue and squirts venom; identifying marks: the iron-studded warts on its back and the bulging throat sac.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：铁钉头似的背斑与鼓胀喉囊。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the nail-head warts and the bulging throat sac.

subject.zh: 高约 1.8 米的戍卒亡魂，下半身化为灰红烟缕，没有腿；身穿旧式步兵锁甲与赭红短披风 #8A4A30，头戴护鼻铁盔 #6A6A68；脸色灰白 #B8B0A4，喉间一道渗红的旧伤 #B33A2A；以长枪刺击、高呼鼓舞同伴；辨识：胸前挂一枚铜军牌，枪上系着褪色队旗。
subject.en: The ghost of a garrison soldier about 1.8 m tall whose lower body becomes gray-red wisps, no legs; old-style infantry mail and a short ochre-red cape #8A4A30, a nasal iron helm #6A6A68; an ashen face #B8B0A4 with an old wound at the throat seeping red #B33A2A; thrusts with a spear and shouts to rally its fellows; identifying marks: a copper tag on its chest, a faded company pennant tied to the spear.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：护鼻铁盔与喉间的旧伤。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the nasal helm and the old wound at the throat.

subject.zh: 身高约 2.2 米的骸骨戍卒，两足直立、肩宽背厚；骨色焦黄 #B8A888，身上层层叠着不同时代的甲，最里锈锁甲、外罩鳞甲、最外是赭红板甲残片 #8A4A30；眼窝两点赤光 #B33A2A；以重斧劈砍、怒吼召唤同袍；辨识：甲叠着甲，像一座会走的旧兵器堆。
subject.en: A skeletal garrison soldier about 2.2 m tall, broad-shouldered on two legs; scorched yellow bones #B8A888 wearing armor from many eras layered one over another, rusty mail innermost, scale over it and scraps of ochre-red plate #8A4A30 outermost; two red sparks #B33A2A in its eye sockets; hews with a heavy axe and roars to call its comrades; identifying mark: armor stacked on armor, like a walking heap of old weapons.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：层层叠起的不同时代的甲。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the layers of armor from different eras.

subject.zh: 长约 1.6 米、悬在离地一米处的一柄白刃，无柄无格；刃身瓷白 #EDE8DC、两面完全对称，中段一道永远张开的红口 #B33A2A；刃周缠着几缕赤黑的烟 #5A1A16；以刃身劈旋、割出流血伤；辨识：白刃上那道不愈的红口。
subject.en: A white blade about 1.6 m long hanging a meter above the ground, with no hilt or guard; porcelain-white steel #EDE8DC, perfectly symmetrical on both faces, with a red gash #B33A2A that never closes across its middle; a few wisps of red-black smoke #5A1A16 wind around it; slashes and spins, leaving bleeding wounds; identifying mark: the unhealing red gash in the white blade.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：白刃中段不愈的红口。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the unhealing red gash in the middle of the blade.

subject.zh: 体长约 1.9 米的大狼，四足；毛色灰黑 #3A3634，背脊与颈后竖起赤黑的角质棘 #5A1A16；身上几道裂开的伤口张着不合、透出暗红 #B33A2A；以獠牙撕咬、群起扑杀；辨识：张开的伤口与颈后一圈角质棘。
subject.en: A big wolf about 1.9 m long, four legs; gray-black fur #3A3634 with red-black horny spines #5A1A16 bristling along the spine and behind the neck; several split wounds that gape and never close, showing dark red #B33A2A; tears with its fangs and hunts in packs; identifying marks: the gaping wounds and the ring of horny spines behind its neck.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：颈后一圈角质棘与张开的伤口。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the ring of horny spines and the gaping wounds.

subject.zh: 高约 1.7 米的幽灵，下半身散成一叠翻飞的旧纸页，没有腿；上身是穿学者长袍的消瘦人形，袍墨蓝灰 #2B2B3A，皮色羊皮纸白 #D8D2C0；身上浮着一行行像字迹的淡紫划痕 #7A6A9A，却认不出任何字；以纸页割伤、复诵让人失语；辨识：嘴一直开合，像在重复同一句话。
subject.en: A ghost about 1.7 m tall whose lower body scatters into a sheaf of fluttering old pages, no legs; its upper body is a gaunt figure in a scholar's robe of ink blue-gray #2B2B3A, with parchment-white skin #D8D2C0; lines of pale violet scratches #7A6A9A that look like writing but form no real letters float over it; cuts with pages and repeats itself until foes fall silent; identifying mark: its mouth keeps moving, as if repeating one sentence.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：浮在身上像字迹的淡紫划痕。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the pale violet writing-like scratches on its body.

subject.zh: 直径约 0.8 米的一团书虱，上百只米粒大的扁虫聚成一片会爬的斑；虫身羊皮纸色 #D8D2C0，背上带墨点 #2B2B3A，群中夹着被啃得残缺的纸屑；以整团啃咬、吸走法力；辨识：虫群爬过的纸屑上留下淡紫色的细划痕 #7A6A9A。
subject.en: A patch of book lice about 0.8 m across, hundreds of rice-grain-sized flat bugs forming a crawling stain; parchment-colored bodies #D8D2C0 with ink dots #2B2B3A on their backs, chewed scraps of paper caught among them; attacks by swarming and gnawing and drains mana; identifying mark: fine pale violet scratches #7A6A9A left on the paper scraps they crawl over.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：被啃残的纸屑与淡紫细划痕。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the chewed paper scraps with pale violet scratches.

subject.zh: 直径约 1 米的悬浮澱灵，没有肢体；核心是一团墨色旋涡 #2B2B3A，周围绕着十几片碎纸屑 #D8D2C0，每片上都是错乱的淡紫划痕 #7A6A9A；纸屑不停重排，像在拼一个名字却总拼错；以纸屑穿刺、封住技能；辨识：核心里偶尔闪出一张模糊的人脸轮廓。
subject.en: A floating sediment spirit about 1 m across with no limbs; its core is an ink-dark whorl #2B2B3A circled by a dozen scraps of paper #D8D2C0, each covered in jumbled pale violet scratches #7A6A9A; the scraps keep rearranging, as if trying to spell a name and always getting it wrong; pierces with paper scraps and locks out skills; identifying mark: the faint outline of a face sometimes flickers in its core.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：墨色核心里模糊的人脸轮廓。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the faint face outline in its ink-dark core.

subject.zh: 翼展约 0.8 米的乌鸦，黑羽 #1F1F28 中夹着几根墨蓝灰的硬羽 #2B2B3A，羽轴发白像削好的笔杆 #D8D2C0；翼面浮着淡紫细划痕 #7A6A9A；嘴里常叼着一张纸片；以喙啄、叼走物品；辨识：尾羽末端像蘸过墨的笔尖，嘴上的纸片。
subject.en: A crow with a wingspan of about 0.8 m, black plumage #1F1F28 with a few stiff ink blue-gray feathers #2B2B3A whose white shafts look like trimmed pen quills #D8D2C0; faint pale violet scratches #7A6A9A on its wings; often carries a scrap of paper in its beak; pecks and snatches items; identifying marks: tail feathers ending like ink-dipped pen nibs, the paper scrap in its beak.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：笔尖似的尾羽与嘴上的纸片。

subject.zh: 直径约 0.8 米的一小群萤火虫，十几只指节大的萤虫绕成松散的光团；虫身暗褐 #3A3428，尾部发着淡黄绿的光 #D0E0A0，光点大小一致；群飞时常排成一个方方的框；不攻击，只会绕人飞；辨识：光点聚成的方框在空中缓缓转动。
subject.en: A small cluster of fireflies about 0.8 m across, a dozen knuckle-sized insects circling in a loose cloud of lights; dark brown bodies #3A3428 with pale yellow-green glowing tails #D0E0A0, every light the same size; in flight they often line up into a square frame; never attacks, only circles people; identifying mark: the square frame of lights slowly turning in the air.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：光点排成的方框。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the square frame formed by the lights.

subject.zh: 体长约 1.8 米的蜥蜴，四足外撇、长尾；鳞片焦黑 #2A2220，鳞缝透出橙红的热光 #D86A2A，背上一排冷却岩浆似的疙瘩 #5A3A2A；眼金黄；以咬与甩尾攻击，体温烫人；辨识：鳞缝间橙红的热纹，口里呼出淡淡热气。
subject.en: A lizard about 1.8 m long with sprawling legs and a long tail; charred black scales #2A2220 with orange-red heat #D86A2A glowing between them, a row of lumps like cooled lava #5A3A2A along its back; golden eyes; bites and lashes its tail, its body hot to the touch; identifying marks: the orange-red heat lines between its scales, faint heat haze from its mouth.

subject.zh: 体长约 0.4 米的小鼠，四足；毛色金褐 #C9A227 杂着土褐 #6B4F1D，腹下垂着一只皮囊，长得像系了口的小钱袋，鼓鼓地装满铜钱；尾巴卷成钩；以门齿咬、偷了钱就跑；辨识：腹下的钱袋皮囊与囊口一圈金色细毛。
subject.en: A small mouse about 0.4 m long on four legs; gold-brown fur #C9A227 mixed with earth brown #6B4F1D, a pouch of skin hanging under its belly shaped like a drawstring coin purse, bulging with coins; a hooked, curled tail; bites with its incisors and runs off with coins; identifying marks: the purse-shaped pouch under its belly with a ring of fine golden fur at its mouth.

subject.zh: 长约 1 米的旧木宝箱，箱盖就是嘴；木板暗褐 #5A4028，包角与搭扣是发绿的黄铜 #8A7A3A，盖缝一圈尖木牙，伸出一条暗红长舌 #8A2A2A；箱底生出四条短粗的木腿；以合盖夹咬、吸走掉落的钱；辨识：盖内侧刻满被划掉的签名似的乱线。
subject.en: An old wooden chest about 1 m long whose lid is its mouth; dark brown boards #5A4028, corner caps and hasp of green-tarnished brass #8A7A3A, a ring of sharp wooden teeth along the lid seam and a long dark red tongue #8A2A2A; four short thick wooden legs under its base; snaps its lid shut on prey and draws in dropped coins; identifying mark: the inside of the lid covered in scrawls like crossed-out signatures.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：盖内侧被划掉的签名似的乱线。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the scrawls like crossed-out signatures inside the lid.

subject.zh: 甲宽约 0.8 米的蟹，八条步足加一对螯；甲壳暗绿 #3A5A40 带金褐斑 #C9A227；两只螯扁平宽大，像一对铜秤盘，边缘磨得发亮；以秤盘螯夹击、偷钱；辨识：两只螯一样大，平平地端着，像在称东西。
subject.en: A crab with a shell about 0.8 m wide, eight walking legs and a pair of claws; dark green shell #3A5A40 with gold-brown spots #C9A227; both claws are broad and flat like a pair of brass scale pans, worn shiny at the edges; pinches with its pan claws and steals coins; identifying mark: two equal claws held level, as if weighing something.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：一对铜秤盘似的扁平大螯。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the pair of flat brass-pan claws.

subject.zh: 直径约 0.8 米的一群小甲虫，几十只铜钱大的圆甲虫挤成一团；每只的鞘翅都是圆形的金褐铜片 #C9A227，正中一个方孔似的暗斑 #3A2A18，边缘发绿 #3A5A40；以整团爬上啃咬、腐蚀；辨识：静止时整群像一摊撒落的铜钱。
subject.en: A cluster of small beetles about 0.8 m across, dozens of coin-sized round beetles crowded together; each has round wing cases like a gold-brown copper disc #C9A227 with a dark square-hole spot #3A2A18 in the middle and green-tarnished edges #3A5A40; swarms over prey to gnaw and corrode; identifying mark: when still, the whole swarm looks like a spill of copper coins.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：铜钱似的圆鞘翅与方孔暗斑。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the coin-like round wing cases with square spots.

subject.zh: 直径约 0.7 米的一团小蠹虫，几十只米粒大的银灰虫 #A8A498 聚成一片翻动的薄云；虫身带着金褐 #C9A227 与墨色 #2B2B3A 的细斑；群中夹着被蛀成细格的纸屑；以整团啃咬、打乱数目；辨识：被它蛀过的纸屑上留下整齐的格状小孔。
subject.en: A cloud of tiny silverfish about 0.7 m across, dozens of rice-grain-sized silver-gray insects #A8A498 forming a shifting haze; their bodies are flecked with gold-brown #C9A227 and ink black #2B2B3A; scraps of paper eaten into fine grids drift among them; attacks by swarming and gnawing and scrambles numbers; identifying mark: the neat grid of tiny holes in the paper they have eaten.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：被蛀成细格的纸屑。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the paper scraps eaten into fine grids.

subject.zh: 身高约 0.6 米的小魔，两足、大头细腿；皮色暗金褐 #8A6A2A，肚子圆鼓，背上一对破纸似的小翅 #D8D2C0；双手攥着一卷撕了一半的契约纸，纸边焦黑；以小爪抓挠、吸走体力；辨识：头顶两只像蜡封印的暗红小角 #8A2A2A。
subject.en: A small fiend about 0.6 m tall on two legs, big head and thin legs; dark gold-brown skin #8A6A2A, a round belly, a pair of small wings like torn paper #D8D2C0 on its back; it clutches a half-torn contract with charred edges; scratches with little claws and saps stamina; identifying mark: two small dark red horns #8A2A2A on its head shaped like wax seals.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：蜡封印似的暗红小角与撕破的契约。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the wax-seal horns and the torn contract.

subject.zh: 高约 3 米的炉渣魔像，两足粗短、双臂垂地；身体是一块块冷却的黑灰炉渣 #3A3634 与锈铁块 #6A4A3A 堆成，裂缝里透出暗橙余温 #C8682A；渣缝里卡着许多烧焦的纸片；以重拳砸地、灼烫攻击；辨识：胸口一块未冷却的橙红渣核，头是一团扁平的渣块。
subject.en: A slag golem about 3 m tall with short thick legs and arms hanging to the ground; its body is piled from lumps of cooled black-gray slag #3A3634 and rusty iron #6A4A3A, dull orange heat #C8682A glowing through the cracks; many scraps of burnt paper are wedged between the slag; slams with heavy fists and scorches; identifying marks: an orange-red slag core still glowing in its chest, a flat lump of slag for a head.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：胸口未冷却的橙红渣核。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the still-glowing orange slag core in its chest.

subject.zh: 肩高约 1.5 米的大雄鹿，四足修长；毛色银白 #D8DCD8，颈下一圈蓬松长毛 #B8C0B8，腿下部浅灰蓝 #9AA8B0；一对高大优雅的枝角，角尖挂着细苔 #8AA078；不主动攻击，被攻击时顶开人就逃；辨识：银白的身影与挂着细苔的高大枝角，神态安详。
subject.en: A great stag about 1.5 m at the shoulder on long legs; silver-white coat #D8DCD8, a ruff of long soft fur #B8C0B8 under the neck, pale blue-gray lower legs #9AA8B0; a pair of tall, graceful antlers with fine moss #8AA078 hanging from the tips; never attacks first and only shoves an attacker away before fleeing; identifying marks: its silver-white figure and tall moss-hung antlers, a calm bearing.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：挂着细苔的高大枝角。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the tall moss-hung antlers.

subject.en: A large moth with a wingspan of about 1 m, four broad wings, six thin legs and a pair of feathery antennae; moon-white wings #E8E8E0 edged in pale green #A8C8A0, each with a silver-gray eyespot #9A9A98 in the middle; a fluffy creamy body; never attacks and only dusts powder when disturbed; identifying marks: the big feathery antennae, a few strands of silver silk trailing from its abdomen.

extra.zh: 整张图的所有帧都朝画面右方（侧面）。
extra.en: Every frame in this sheet faces screen right (side view).

subject.zh: 翼展约 1.2 米的大鸮，平盘圆脸，一对耳簇竖起；羽色银灰 #A8ACB0 带深灰横纹 #5A5E62，脸盘浅白 #E0E0DC；一对大圆眼淡金 #D8C890；以爪俯冲抓击；辨识：平盘圆脸与竖起的耳簇，翼下羽毛浅白如月光。
subject.en: A large owl with a wingspan of about 1.2 m, a flat round facial disc and a pair of upright ear tufts; silver-gray plumage #A8ACB0 barred with dark gray #5A5E62, a pale white facial disc #E0E0DC; big round pale gold eyes #D8C890; swoops to strike with its talons; identifying marks: the flat round face and upright ear tufts, underwing feathers pale as moonlight.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：平盘圆脸与竖起的耳簇。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the flat round face and upright ear tufts.

subject.zh: 体长约 1.7 米的狼，四足；毛色灰白 #B8B8B0，颈后一圈结霜的硬鬃 #D8E0E8，鬃里冒出几枚赤黑角突 #5A1A16；肩背的毛里长着橄榄绿苔斑 #6B7F3A；以獠牙撕咬、带霜扑击；辨识：结霜的颈鬃里同时长着苔与角。
subject.en: A wolf about 1.7 m long, four legs; gray-white fur #B8B8B0 with a ruff of frosted stiff bristles #D8E0E8 behind its neck and a few red-black horn knobs #5A1A16 poking through it; olive-green moss patches #6B7F3A grow in the fur of its shoulders and back; tears with its fangs and pounces with frost; identifying mark: moss and horns growing together in its frosted neck ruff.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：结霜颈鬃里的苔与角突。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the moss and horn knobs in its frosted ruff.

subject.zh: 体长约 1.8 米、以鹿尸为核的菌傀，四足僵硬地走；骨架外裹满菌丝与苔 #6B7F3A，一侧烂出空洞 #4A3B2A，另一侧长满淡黄伞菌 #C9C1A0；头是一只鹿头骨，空眼窝里长出细菌柄；以菌角顶撞、孢子爆散；辨识：鹿头骨上长着一簇伞菌，走过处落下孢粉。
subject.en: A fungal husk about 1.8 m long built around a deer carcass, walking stiffly on four legs; its skeleton is wrapped in mycelium and moss #6B7F3A, one side rotted into hollows #4A3B2A and the other crowded with pale yellow mushrooms #C9C1A0; its head is a deer skull with thin stalks growing from the empty eye sockets; butts with fungal antlers and bursts into spores; identifying marks: a cluster of mushrooms on the deer skull, spore dust falling where it walks.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：长着一簇伞菌的鹿头骨。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the deer skull crowned with mushrooms.

subject.zh: 直径约 1.5 米的一团疯长藤，十几根手腕粗的藤蔓缠成球，没有固定的头尾；藤色橄榄绿 #6B7F3A，一边开满淡白小花 #C9C1A0，另一边发黑腐烂 #4A3B2A、渗出暗汁；藤上满是倒刺；以藤蔓缠绕、刺伤；辨识：同一根藤一头开花一头烂。
subject.en: A ball of rampant vines about 1.5 m across, a dozen wrist-thick vines knotted together with no fixed front or back; olive-green vines #6B7F3A, covered in small pale white flowers #C9C1A0 on one side and rotting black #4A3B2A and oozing dark sap on the other; barbed thorns all over; entangles and pricks; identifying mark: one vine flowering at one end and rotting at the other.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：一头开花一头腐烂的藤。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: a vine flowering at one end and rotting at the other.

subject.zh: 高约 0.8 米的大菇，不会移动；伞盖鼓成一个圆球，灰白 #C9C1A0 带橄榄绿霉斑 #6B7F3A，顶上一圈裂口像王冠；菌柄粗短、暗褐 #4A3B2A，根部簇生几只小菇；被碰到就孢爆致病；辨识：伞盖顶上冠状的裂口，裂口里透出黄绿孢粉。
subject.en: A big puffball mushroom about 0.8 m tall that never moves; its cap swells into a round ball, gray-white #C9C1A0 with olive-green mildew spots #6B7F3A, a ring of splits at the top like a crown; a short thick dark brown stem #4A3B2A with a few small mushrooms clustered at its base; bursts into sickening spores when touched; identifying mark: the crown of splits on top with yellow-green spore dust showing inside.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：伞盖顶上冠状的裂口。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the crown of splits on top of the cap.

subject.en: A bear about 2.8 m tall when rearing, four legs; dark brown fur #4A3B2A with a thick carpet of moss and ferns #6B7F3A on its back, white flowers #C9C1A0 blooming in the moss beside blackened rot; a few spike-like woody branches growing from its shoulders; swipes with its forepaws and pricks with the spikes on its back; identifying marks: a back overgrown like a little mossy slope, cloudy yellowed eyes.

subject.zh: 身长约 2 米的空蝗蜕，六条节腿、背上残留一对破翅；蜕壳枯黄 #C9C1A0，节缝发黑 #4A3B2A，背上裂开一道长缝，缝里不时爬出小蝗；复眼空洞，壳上布满橄榄绿霉斑 #6B7F3A；以前足钩扑、放出蝗群；辨识：背上的裂缝与从里面爬出的小蝗。

subject.en: A wild bull about 1.9 m at the shoulder on thick legs, with a towering shoulder hump; long black-brown fur #2A2220, a pair of massive horns stained dark red #8A2A2A with several small red-black horns #5A1A16 sprouting at their bases; old wounds on its body that gape and never close #B33A2A; gores and tramples in stampeding herds; identifying marks: the dark red horns and the cluster of small horns at their roots.

subject.zh: 高约 2.6 米的骸骨战士，两足直立，骨架上嵌满蝗虫的甲壳与腿；骨色枯黄 #C9C1A0，甲片间长着橄榄绿霉 #6B7F3A，几处伤骨渗着暗红 #B33A2A，额骨上一块对称的瓷白斑 #EDE8DC；以骨刃劈砍、放出骨蝗；辨识：胸腔里栖着一群骨质小蝗，背上一对破蝗翅。
subject.en: A skeletal warrior about 2.6 m tall on two legs, its bones studded all over with locust shells and legs; dry yellow bone #C9C1A0 with olive-green mildew #6B7F3A between the plates, a few wounded bones seeping dark red #B33A2A, a symmetrical porcelain-white patch #EDE8DC on its brow; hacks with bony blades and releases bone locusts; identifying marks: a swarm of small bony locusts nesting in its ribcage, a pair of ragged locust wings on its back.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：胸腔里栖着的骨质小蝗。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the small bony locusts nesting in its ribcage.

subject.zh: 高约 1.8 米的兽人祭司游魂，下半身散成青灰烟缕，没有腿；身披赭红毡袍 #8A3A2A 与兽骨饰，头戴羽冠，灰白面孔 #B8B0A4 上长着一对尖兽耳；袍上生着青苔 #6B7F3A，也带着暗红旧刀伤；以骨杖敲击、威吓；辨识：颈上一串兽牙念珠，眼窝里淡淡的绿光。
subject.en: The wandering ghost of a beastfolk shaman about 1.8 m tall whose lower body dissolves into blue-gray wisps, no legs; an ochre-red felt robe #8A3A2A with bone ornaments, a feathered crown, a gray-white face #B8B0A4 with a pair of pointed animal ears; moss #6B7F3A grows on the robe beside old dark red sword cuts; strikes with a bone staff and intimidates; identifying marks: a string of fang beads at its neck, a faint green light in its eye sockets.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：兽牙念珠与羽冠下的尖兽耳。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the fang beads and the pointed ears under the feathered crown.

subject.zh: 肩高约 1.1 米的驯鹿，四足粗壮、蹄宽；厚毛灰褐 #7A6A58，颈下一圈蓬松白毛 #E0DCD0，吻部浅灰；一对后弯多叉的鹿角 #B8A890，前额还有一枝向前伸的眉叉；以角顶撞、蹄踢；辨识：颈下白毛与向前伸的眉叉，干净的野生毛色。
subject.en: A reindeer about 1.1 m at the shoulder on sturdy legs with broad hooves; thick gray-brown coat #7A6A58, a fluffy white ruff #E0DCD0 under the neck, pale gray muzzle; a pair of back-swept many-tined antlers #B8A890 with one brow tine reaching forward over the face; butts with its antlers and kicks; identifying marks: the white neck ruff and the forward-reaching brow tine, clean wild coloring.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：向前伸的眉叉与颈下白毛。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the forward brow tine and the white neck ruff.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：额上短角与赤黑的背鬃。

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：额上一对小角与暗红喙尖。

subject.zh: 身高约 1.8 米的亡灵斗士，两足直立；灰白干皮 #B8B0A4 贴骨，光着上身，缠着赤黑护腕与腰带 #5A1A16，下穿破旧的斗士短裙；胸前一道致命旧伤张着 #B33A2A；双手持一柄缺口弯刀；以弯刀连斩；辨识：腰上系着一条褪色的决斗绶带，左臂缠着断链。
subject.en: An undead duelist about 1.8 m tall on two legs; gray-white dry skin #B8B0A4 over bone, bare-chested, with red-black bracers and belt #5A1A16 and a ragged gladiator's kilt; an old mortal wound gaping across its chest #B33A2A; holds a notched curved blade in both hands; strikes in rapid cuts; identifying marks: a faded dueling sash tied at its waist, a broken chain wrapped around its left arm.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：褪色的决斗绶带与胸前旧伤。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the faded dueling sash and the wound on its chest.

subject.zh: 高约 1.8 米、没长完的澱生体，形体不全：一侧是粗壮的臂，另一侧只是一团鼓动的澱块；表皮暗红 #5A1A16 与黑 #1C1A1A，裂纹透出赤红 #B33A2A；头部只长出几只零乱的角芽；以畸形的臂横扫、冲撞；辨识：身体左右不对称，表面像胎膜一样微微搏动。
subject.en: An unfinished sediment creature about 1.8 m tall with an incomplete form: a thick arm on one side and only a pulsing lump of sediment on the other; dark red #5A1A16 and black #1C1A1A skin with red #B33A2A showing through the cracks; only a few scattered horn buds on its head; sweeps with its misshapen arm and rams; identifying marks: a lopsided body whose surface throbs faintly like a membrane.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：左右不对称的身体与零乱角芽。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the lopsided body and the scattered horn buds.

subject.zh: 高约 2.8 米、以一副巨大角冠为头的澱生体，四肢粗短，躯干是一团赤黑的澱 #1C1A1A；头上的角冠由十几只弯角盘成，色暗红 #5A1A16，角尖发亮 #B33A2A；没有脸，角冠下只有一道裂口；以角冠冲撞、践踏；辨识：头顶那副像王冠一样盘起的大角。
subject.en: A sediment creature about 2.8 m tall whose head is a great crown of horns, with short thick limbs and a trunk of red-black sediment #1C1A1A; the crown is a dozen curved horns coiled together, dark red #5A1A16 with gleaming tips #B33A2A; no face, only a split beneath the crown; rams with its horn crown and tramples; identifying mark: the huge horns coiled on its head like a crown.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：王冠般盘起的角冠。

subject.en: A great white bear about 3 m tall when rearing, four legs; thick creamy white fur #E8E8E0 tipped with pale blue-gray #B8C8D0, broad paws with black claws #2A2A2E; a long neck, small head and long body; smashes with frosted forepaws and bites; identifying marks: the long creamy fur and long neck, rime frosting its muzzle.

subject.zh: 肩高约 2 米的野牦牛，四足粗短；长长的黑褐毛 #2A2220 垂到膝下，肩背隆起；一对向上弯的粗角，角尖发白 #D8D0C0；吻部灰白 #A8A098；以角冲撞、践踏；辨识：垂地的长毛裙与隆起的肩背，干净的野生毛色。
subject.en: A wild yak about 2 m at the shoulder on short thick legs; long black-brown hair #2A2220 hanging below the knees, a humped back; a pair of thick upward-curving horns with whitish tips #D8D0C0; a gray-white muzzle #A8A098; charges with its horns and tramples; identifying marks: the skirt of hair sweeping the ground and the humped back, clean wild coloring.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：垂地的长毛裙与上弯的角。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the sweeping skirt of hair and the upturned horns.

subject.zh: 翼展约 3 米的巨鹫，双翼长而宽；羽色深灰 #4A4A4E，翼下一大片白 #E0E0DC，颈根一圈蓬松灰领羽；秃头灰蓝 #8A9AA8，钩喙粗大；以俯冲撞击、利爪抓；辨识：翼下大片的白与宽如门板的翼展。
subject.en: A giant vulture with a wingspan of about 3 m and long broad wings; dark gray plumage #4A4A4E with a large white patch #E0E0DC under each wing, a fluffy gray ruff at the base of the neck; a bald blue-gray head #8A9AA8 and a heavy hooked beak; dives to ram and grabs with its talons; identifying marks: the broad white underwings and wings as wide as a door.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：翼下的大片白与灰领羽。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the white underwings and the gray ruff.

subject.zh: 体长约 0.7 米的甲虫，六条短节腿；鞘翅深蓝黑 #1A1E2A，上面散着许多细小的银白闪点 #D8E0F0，像一片夜空；头上一对短而厚的颚，前端磨得发亮；以颚咬、硬甲格挡；辨识：背上星空般的闪点。
subject.en: A beetle about 0.7 m long on six short jointed legs; deep blue-black wing cases #1A1E2A scattered with many tiny silver-white glints #D8E0F0 like a patch of night sky; a pair of short thick mandibles worn shiny at the tips; bites with its mandibles and blocks with its hard shell; identifying mark: the starry glints on its back.

subject.zh: 体长约 1 米的小蜥，四足、长尾，头比一般蜥蜴大；鳞片冰蓝灰 #8A9AA8，鳞缘泛银 #D0D8E0，背上一排小鳍棘；头后一对细小角芽；以咬与弱吐息攻击，口里冒出细细火星；辨识：鳞片比身体大得多，像一片片拼上去的龙鳞。
subject.en: A small lizard about 1 m long, four legs and a long tail, its head larger than an ordinary lizard's; ice blue-gray scales #8A9AA8 with silver edges #D0D8E0, a row of small fin spines on its back; a pair of tiny horn buds behind its head; bites and gives weak breath attacks, small sparks escaping its mouth; identifying mark: scales far too big for its body, like dragon scales pieced onto it.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：拼上去似的过大鳞片。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the oversized pieced-on scales.

subject.en: A young dragonkin about 2.6 m tall on its hind legs, with short wings and a long tail; half its body is newly grown gray-white scales #C8C8C0 and half is exposed ancient dragon bone #E0D8C8, with a layer of ash #8A8580 beneath the bone; a row of bare bone spikes along its spine; attacks with claws and bone spikes and chills to the bone; identifying marks: the bare spinal spikes and the ash beneath the bone.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：外露的脊骨刺与骨下的灰。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the bare spinal spikes and the ash under the bone.

subject.zh: 站高约 4 米的大亚龙，后腿双足、巨大膜翼、长颈长尾；骨架是古老的灰白龙骨 #E0D8C8，骨上新长出一片片暗灰鳞 #4A4A50，鳞缝透出淡紫光 #C6B5E0；翼膜残破、露出翼骨；以吐息、扑咬、震慑攻击；辨识：骨架与新鳞交错，像一具长出了皮的龙骸。
subject.en: A great drake about 4 m tall on its hind legs, with huge membrane wings, long neck and long tail; its frame is ancient gray-white dragon bone #E0D8C8 sprouting patches of new dark gray scales #4A4A50, pale lavender light #C6B5E0 showing between the scales; its wing membranes are torn, exposing the wing bones; breathes, bites and terrifies; identifying mark: bone and new scale interlaced, like a dragon skeleton growing back its skin.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：骨架与新鳞交错的身体。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the interlaced bone and new scales.

subject.zh: 高约 1.8 米、扁平得像墙上影子的人形，侧面看也只有一指厚；身体是深灰的影 #4D4A52，叠着几道门框形的浮雕线纹 #8A8580，像从墙里剥下来的；没有五官，嘴的位置是一道竖缝，透出淡紫光 #C6B5E0；以伸出的手掌拍击、令人失声；辨识：身上叠印的门框线纹。
subject.en: A humanoid about 1.8 m tall, flat as a shadow on a wall and only a finger thick from the side; its body is a dark gray shade #4D4A52 overlaid with several door-frame relief lines #8A8580, as if peeled off the wall; no features, only a vertical slit where a mouth would be, with pale lavender light #C6B5E0 inside; strikes with reaching palms and silences; identifying mark: the door-frame lines printed across its body.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：叠印的门框线纹与竖缝之口。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the printed door-frame lines and the slit mouth.

subject.zh: 直径约 1.2 米的一团飞舞焦页，二三十张巴掌大的旧纸页被灰气托着旋转；纸色焦黄 #C8B890，边缘烧成黑褐 #3A3028，页面只有焦痕与灰斑 #8A8580；团心一缕淡紫灰烟 #C6B5E0；以锋利的页边割伤；辨识：纸页总是绕着同一个中心打旋。
subject.en: A whirling cloud of scorched pages about 1.2 m across, twenty or thirty palm-sized old sheets carried round by ashy air; scorched yellow paper #C8B890 with edges burnt black-brown #3A3028, the pages bearing only scorch marks and ash stains #8A8580; a wisp of pale lavender smoke #C6B5E0 at the center; cuts with sharp page edges; identifying mark: the pages always circle the same center.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：绕着团心打旋的焦页。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the scorched pages circling the center.

subject.zh: 身高约 1.6 米的提灯亡灵，两足、弓背；灰白干皮 #C8C0B0，穿旧式白麻长衫 #E0DAC8，袖口与下摆烧得焦黑；手提一盏铜灯 #B8A060，灯里跳着瓷白冷焰 #EDE8DC；脸平静而对称；以灯焰灼烧、为主人回复；辨识：衣上落满纸灰，提灯的手被烫得焦黑。
subject.en: A lantern-bearing undead about 1.6 m tall, stooped on two legs; gray-white dry skin #C8C0B0, an old-style white linen gown #E0DAC8 with charred cuffs and hem; it carries a brass lantern #B8A060 in which a porcelain-white cold flame #EDE8DC flickers; a calm, symmetrical face; scorches with the lantern flame and restores its master; identifying marks: paper ash all over its clothes, the lantern hand burnt black.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：铜灯里的瓷白冷焰。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the porcelain-white flame in the brass lantern.

subject.zh: 高约 1.2 米、钟口朝下的钟形晶体，悬在半空，没有肢体；晶体瓷白 #E8EEF2，钟缘一圈淡金 #D8C27A，钟腔里吊着一枚淡蓝晶舌 #9DB4C8；外壁刻着对称的几何纹；以晶舌撞击发出震波；辨识：整个晶体就是一口悬着的钟，左右完全对称。
subject.en: A bell-shaped crystal about 1.2 m tall hanging in the air mouth-down, no limbs; porcelain-white crystal #E8EEF2 with a pale gold rim #D8C27A, a pale blue crystal clapper #9DB4C8 hanging inside; symmetrical geometric patterns carved on its outer wall; strikes with its clapper to send out shock waves; identifying mark: the whole crystal is a hanging bell, perfectly symmetrical.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：钟腔里的淡蓝晶舌。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the pale blue crystal clapper inside.

subject.zh: 直径约 4 米、堵在井口上的一张泥巨口，不会移动；一圈翻卷的灰褐泥唇 #6E6250，唇上嵌满碎瓦、鱼骨与瓷白小晶片 #EDE8DC，口腔深处是暗紫的泥浆 #4A3A62；唇边伸出几条粗泥舌；以泥舌卷打、吐出泥魔；辨识：张合时口里涌出一团团人形的泥。
subject.en: A giant mouth of mud about 4 m across plugging a well head, unable to move; a ring of curling gray-brown mud lips #6E6250 studded with broken tiles, fish bones and small porcelain-white crystal chips #EDE8DC, dark violet slurry #4A3A62 deep in its throat; a few thick mud tongues reach out from its lips; lashes with its mud tongues and spits out mud fiends; identifying mark: lumps of man-shaped mud welling up from its mouth as it opens and closes.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：口里涌出的人形泥团。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the man-shaped lumps of mud welling from its mouth.

items.notes: 先做本条：主审通过后它是本主体全部动作表的参照图。剧情精英（城下潮）；只画泥口本身，不画井与地面。

subject.zh: 身高约 1.9 米的亡灵旗手，两足直立，全身结着厚霜；冻僵的皮肉青灰 #6A7A8A，穿旧式北境锁甲与暗红罩袍 #5A1A16，伤口张着冻住的红 #B33A2A；双手擎一面结冰的破军旗 #8A2A2A；以旗杆砸击、挥旗鼓舞亡兵；辨识：那面冻硬的破旗，旗面没有图案。
subject.en: An undead standard-bearer about 1.9 m tall standing on two legs, coated in thick frost; frozen blue-gray flesh #6A7A8A, old-style northern mail and a dark red surcoat #5A1A16, wounds gaping with frozen red #B33A2A; it holds up a tattered war banner #8A2A2A stiff with ice; smashes with the banner pole and waves the banner to rally the dead; identifying mark: the frozen, tattered banner with no device on it.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：冻硬的破军旗。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the frozen tattered banner.

subject.zh: 身高约 1 米、孩童模样的霜灵，两足；全身像一尊白瓷娃娃 #EDE8DC，脸圆而对称、没有表情，头发与衣裳都是硬瓷雕出的霜花纹，泛淡蓝 #9DB4C8；指尖结着冰晶；以冰晶指尖刺、为亡灵回复；辨识：左右完全对称，碎裂时迸出瓷片而不是冰块。
subject.en: A frost spirit about 1 m tall in the shape of a child, on two legs; its whole body looks like a white porcelain doll #EDE8DC with a round, symmetrical, expressionless face, hair and clothes carved as hard porcelain frost patterns tinged pale blue #9DB4C8; ice crystals form at its fingertips; stabs with its icy fingertips and restores the undead; identifying marks: perfect left-right symmetry, and it shatters into porcelain shards, not ice.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：对称的瓷娃娃脸与霜花纹。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the symmetrical porcelain-doll face and frost patterns.

subject.en: An undead overseer about 1.8 m tall on two legs; dry gray hide #8A8580, old-style mail under a faded white surcoat #D8D2C0, a long stole faded to gray-red #8A5A50 over its shoulders; an open old prayer book in one hand and a short whip in the other; lashes with the whip and chants prayers that rally the dead; identifying marks: a larger cross-shaped holy seal on its chest than its workers wear, a ring of iron keys at its belt.

subject.zh: 直径约 1 米的一群门牌，十几块巴掌大的旧铜牌与木牌被灰气托着乱撞；铜牌发绿 #6A8A6A、木牌焦褐 #6A5038，每块都有钉孔与断钉；中间缠着一缕淡紫灰烟 #C6B5E0；以门牌撞击使人踉跄；辨识：牌面只有门形图样与几何格，没有字。
subject.en: A flock of door plates about 1 m across, a dozen palm-sized old copper and wooden plaques clattering about on ashy air; verdigris copper plates #6A8A6A and scorched brown wooden ones #6A5038, each with nail holes and broken nails; a wisp of pale lavender smoke #C6B5E0 twists through the middle; rams people off balance; identifying mark: the plates bear only door shapes and geometric grids, never writing.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：带钉孔与门形图样的旧门牌。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the old door plates with nail holes and door shapes.
