subject.zh: 身高约 1.7 米的亡灵读者，平时盘坐，起身后两足行走；全身蒙着细灰 #8A8580，穿千年前式样的学者长袍 #6A6258，头戴软帽；膝上或手里摊着一本厚书，书页灰白 #C8C0B0；以书本拍击、令人失声；辨识：低头读书的姿势，一根手指始终压在书页上。
subject.en: An undead reader about 1.7 m tall who sits cross-legged and walks on two legs once it rises; covered in fine ash #8A8580, wearing a scholar's long robe #6A6258 of a style a thousand years old and a soft cap; a thick book lies open on its knees or in its hands, the pages gray-white #C8C0B0; strikes with the book and silences; identifying marks: its head bowed over the book, one finger always pressed to the page.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：摊开的厚书与压在页上的手指。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the open book and the finger pressed to the page.

subject.zh: 宽约 1 米的一摊会爬的墨渍，没有骨骼，边缘伸出七八条细短的墨爪；墨色深蓝黑 #2B2B3A，表面泛淡紫油光 #7A6A9A，中间浮着几片羊皮纸色碎屑 #D8D2C0；以墨爪抓挠、泼墨扰乱；辨识：形状像一滩溅开的墨，爪尖拖着墨点。
subject.en: A crawling ink blot about 1 m wide with no skeleton, seven or eight short thin ink claws reaching from its edges; deep blue-black ink #2B2B3A with a pale violet oily sheen #7A6A9A, a few parchment-colored scraps #D8D2C0 floating in the middle; scratches with its ink claws and splashes ink to scramble; identifying marks: shaped like a splash of spilled ink, its claw tips trailing drops.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：溅开的墨形与墨爪。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the splash shape and its ink claws.

subject.zh: 甲宽约 1.2 米的蟹，八条步足加一对螯；背上驮着一块空心圆石当壳，石皮灰褐 #6A6058，石壳裂口里露出紫灰色晶簇 #8A80A0 与淡蓝晶尖 #9DB4C8；螯短而厚；以厚螯夹击、缩进石壳硬挡；辨识：背上那块剖开就是晶洞的圆石。
subject.en: A crab about 1.2 m across with eight walking legs and a pair of claws; it carries a hollow round stone as its shell, gray-brown rind #6A6058 with gray-violet crystal clusters #8A80A0 and pale blue crystal points #9DB4C8 showing through a crack; short thick claws; pinches with its claws and withdraws into its stone shell to block; identifying mark: the round stone on its back that opens into a geode.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：石壳裂口里的晶簇。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the crystal clusters in the cracked stone shell.

subject.zh: 身高约 1.6 米的亡灵老矿工头，两足、驼背；灰白胡子结着煤灰，干皮灰褐 #6A5E50，穿厚皮坎肩与粗布裤 #5A4A38；手提一盏始终亮着的老矿灯，灯光暖黄 #E0B860；以镐柄敲击，灯被打碎就发狂吓人；辨识：腰间挂着一卷用麻绳捆好的名册。

subject.zh: 身高约 1.6 米的亡灵，平时坐着，两足；全身是灰烬色 #8A8580 的人形，穿千年前式样的家常衣裳 #7A6E62，肩上搭着一条毯子；双手抱膝，抬头时脸只有模糊的轮廓；以冰冷的手抓握、寒气侵骨；辨识：坐着抱膝的姿势，赤着一双灰白的脚。
subject.en: An undead about 1.6 m tall who usually sits, walking on two legs when it rises; an ash-colored figure #8A8580 in everyday clothes #7A6E62 of a style a thousand years old, a blanket over its shoulders; it hugs its knees, and when it looks up its face is only a blurred outline; grips with cold hands and chills to the bone; identifying marks: the seated knee-hugging pose and a pair of bare gray-white feet.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：抱膝而坐的姿势与赤脚。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the knee-hugging seated pose and the bare feet.

subject.zh: 高约 2.6 米、会走路的石木门框，两根门柱当腿迈步，门楣在上；门框由灰石 #8A8580 与焦黑木料 #3A3430 拼成，框内空空，透过去看得见背后；门楣上挂着一块空白门牌，框边缠着淡紫灰烟 #C6B5E0；以门柱踢踏、把人吸进框里；辨识：一扇没有门板、会走的门框。

subject.zh: 高约 2.6 米、会走路的石木门框，两根门柱当腿迈步，门楣在上；门框由灰石 #8A8580 与焦黑木料 #3A3430 拼成，框内空空，透过去看得见背后；门楣上挂着一块空白门牌，框边缠着淡紫灰烟 #C6B5E0；以门柱踢踏、把人吸进框里；辨识：一扇没有门板、会走的门框。
subject.en: A walking door frame of stone and wood about 2.6 m tall, striding on its two posts with the lintel on top; built of gray stone #8A8580 and charred black timber #3A3430, empty inside so you can see straight through it; a blank door plate hangs from the lintel, pale lavender smoke #C6B5E0 coiling around the frame; stamps with its posts and draws people through itself; identifying mark: a door frame with no door, walking.

subject.zh: 身高约 1.7 米的亡灵圣徒，两足直立；皮肉干枯如瓷 #EDE8DC，脸却安详对称、带着微笑；身披旧式白法衣与淡金肩带 #D8C27A，脚踝拖着一截淡蓝的细链 #9DB4C8；双手合十；以瓷白的手掌按击、为同伴回复；辨识：额上一枚对称的瓷片印记，背上背着一只小骨匣。
subject.en: An undead saint about 1.7 m tall standing on two legs; flesh dried like porcelain #EDE8DC, yet a serene, symmetrical, smiling face; an old-style white vestment with a pale gold stole #D8C27A, a length of fine pale blue chain #9DB4C8 trailing from one ankle; palms pressed together; strikes with porcelain-white palms and restores its allies; identifying marks: a symmetrical porcelain sigil on its brow, a small reliquary box on its back.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：额上的瓷片印记与背上的小骨匣。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the porcelain sigil on its brow and the small reliquary on its back.

subject.zh: 直径约 1 米的一团蛾群，二十来只巴掌大的蛾子绕着打转；蛾翅羊皮纸色 #D8D2C0，翅面排着一格格整齐的墨色小方块 #2B2B3A，像目录的格子；触角淡紫 #7A6A9A；以整团扑面、令人失声；辨识：蛾群飞成一层层整齐的横排，像书架。
subject.en: A cluster of moths about 1 m across, twenty or so palm-sized moths circling together; parchment-colored wings #D8D2C0 printed with rows of neat ink-black squares #2B2B3A like the boxes of a catalog; pale violet antennae #7A6A9A; swarms into faces and silences; identifying mark: the moths fly in neat stacked rows, like shelves.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：翅上一格格的墨色方块。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the grids of ink squares on the wings.

subject.zh: 高约 0.8 米的一枚大印章，没有手脚，靠跳动前进；印身暗红漆木 #6A2A2A，箍着铁圈 #4A4A4E，顶上一个圆球握柄；底面的印面黑亮 #2B2B3A，刻着交叉格纹与划线，没有字；以跳起砸盖封住对手的技能；辨识：落地时印面朝下重重一顿。
subject.en: A big stamp about 0.8 m tall with no limbs that moves by hopping; dark red lacquered wood #6A2A2A bound with iron hoops #4A4A4E, a round knob handle on top; the glossy black stamping face #2B2B3A is cut with crossing grid lines and strikes, never letters; leaps and slams down to lock out a foe's skills; identifying mark: it lands face-down with a heavy thud.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：刻着交叉格纹的黑亮印面。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the glossy black face cut with crossing grid lines.

subject.zh: 高约 1.7 米的学徒亡影，下半身散成灰雾，没有腿；身穿灰袍 #6A6A70，袖口沾满墨迹 #2B2B3A，脸年轻而模糊；一手握羽笔，笔尖滴着淡紫的墨 #7A6A9A，身边浮着几张纸条；以羽笔刺、改写他人的增益；辨识：手里一支羽笔，耳后还夹着另一支。
subject.en: The shade of an apprentice about 1.7 m tall whose lower body dissolves into gray mist, no legs; a gray robe #6A6A70 with ink-stained cuffs #2B2B3A and a young, blurred face; a quill in one hand dripping pale violet ink #7A6A9A, a few slips of paper floating around it; stabs with the quill and rewrites its foes' blessings; identifying marks: a quill in its hand and a second one tucked behind its ear.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：手中滴墨的羽笔与耳后的笔。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the dripping quill in its hand and the one behind its ear.

subject.zh: 高约 1.8 米、由沙聚成的斗士人形，下半身是一团流动的沙，没有腿；沙色赭红 #A8603A，夹着暗红的血沙 #5A1A16；身上嵌着几片锈蚀的斗士护甲 #6A5A48，手握一柄沙凝成的短剑；以沙剑劈砍、扬沙；辨识：身体不停往下流沙，又从底部吸回去。
subject.en: A gladiator figure about 1.8 m tall made of gathered sand, its lower body a pool of flowing sand, no legs; ochre-red sand #A8603A streaked with dark red blood-sand #5A1A16; a few pieces of rusted gladiator armor #6A5A48 are lodged in its body, and it grips a short sword of packed sand; slashes with the sand sword and throws sand; identifying mark: sand constantly pouring down its body and being drawn back up from below.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：不停下流又吸回的沙身。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the sand body pouring down and drawn back up.

subject.zh: 身高约 1.8 米的溺死港工，两足、肩宽；泡胀的皮肉青灰 #5A6B6E，挂着藤壶，光着膀子，系粗布腰带 #6A5A48；肩上扛着一捆湿缆绳，绳头拖在身后；以缆绳抽打、套索缠人；辨识：背上压着一只滴水的货箱，箱角包着锈铜 #8A7A3A。
subject.en: A drowned dockworker about 1.8 m tall, broad-shouldered on two legs; bloated blue-gray flesh #5A6B6E crusted with barnacles, bare-chested with a coarse cloth belt #6A5A48; a coil of wet rope over its shoulder with the end dragging behind; lashes with the rope and snares with a noose; identifying mark: a dripping cargo crate on its back with rusty copper corners #8A7A3A.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：背上的货箱与湿缆绳。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the crate on its back and the wet rope.

subject.zh: 身高约 0.7 米的小魔，两足，身体像一张折起来的契约纸；纸皮羊皮纸色 #D8D2C0，边缘撕裂、焦黑，身上横着几道暗红的断线 #8A2A2A；头是一枚裂开的蜡封，裂缝里两点金光 #C9A227；以纸刃割伤、加重施法代价；辨识：身体的折痕处不停撕开又粘回。
subject.en: A small fiend about 0.7 m tall on two legs whose body is like a folded contract; parchment-colored paper skin #D8D2C0 with torn, charred edges and a few dark red broken lines #8A2A2A across it; its head is a cracked wax seal with two golden glints #C9A227 in the crack; cuts with paper edges and raises the cost of casting; identifying mark: its body keeps tearing open along the folds and sealing back.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：裂开的蜡封头。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: its cracked wax-seal head.

subject.zh: 直径约 1.2 米的一团蛾群，二三十只灰绿蛾子绕成翻涌的团；蛾翅暗橄榄 #6B7F3A，翅脉上长着白色菌丝 #C9C1A0，身体肥软暗褐 #4A3B2A；团中飘着细细的孢粉；以整团扑面、传播病气；辨识：每只蛾翅上都有一块像兽骨的灰白斑。
subject.en: A churning cluster of moths about 1.2 m across, twenty or thirty gray-green moths circling together; dark olive wings #6B7F3A with white mycelium #C9C1A0 growing along the veins, plump soft dark brown bodies #4A3B2A; fine spore dust drifts through the cluster; swarms into faces and spreads sickness; identifying mark: a gray-white mark shaped like an animal bone on every wing.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：翅上兽骨形的灰白斑。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the bone-shaped gray-white wing marks.

subject.zh: 身高约 1.9 米的兽人亡战士，两足直立；灰白干皮 #B8B0A4，头上一对尖兽耳，穿赭红毡甲 #8A3A2A 与兽皮护肩；胸前一道致命旧伤张着 #B33A2A；双手各持一柄短弯刀；以双刀连斩、割出流血伤；辨识：额上画着血红的纹，腰间挂着一串骨饰。
subject.en: An undead beastfolk warrior about 1.9 m tall on two legs; gray-white dry skin #B8B0A4, a pair of pointed animal ears, ochre-red felt armor #8A3A2A and fur pauldrons; an old mortal wound gaping on its chest #B33A2A; a short curved blade in each hand; cuts in flurries that leave bleeding wounds; identifying marks: blood-red markings painted on its brow, a string of bone ornaments at its waist.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：额上的血红纹与尖兽耳。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the blood-red brow markings and the pointed ears.

subject.zh: 高约 0.8 米的一团熔渣小灵，没有肢体，像一块会跳的渣球；外壳是冷却的黑灰渣皮 #3A3634，裂缝里翻着橙红熔渣 #D86A2A，顶上冒着几缕黄烟；表面粘着几粒金褐碎屑 #C9A227；以溅射火渣灼烧；辨识：一跳一顿，落下时渣皮裂开、露出熔芯。
subject.en: A small slag sprite about 0.8 m tall with no limbs, like a hopping ball of slag; its crust is cooled black-gray slag #3A3634 with orange-red molten slag #D86A2A churning in the cracks and a few wisps of yellow smoke on top; a few gold-brown flecks #C9A227 stuck to its surface; scorches with spattered cinders; identifying mark: it hops and lands, and its crust cracks open to show the molten core as it comes down.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：裂开的渣皮下的熔芯。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the molten core under the cracking crust.

subject.zh: 高约 2.6 米的风箱傀儡，两足粗短；躯干是一只巨大的皮风箱 #6A4A30，铁箍 #4A4A4E 钉着铆钉，胸前一个黄铜喷嘴 #8A7A3A；双臂是两根铁杠，一推一拉鼓动风箱；以喷嘴鼓出狂风击退；辨识：胸口的风箱随动作一鼓一瘪。
subject.en: A bellows golem about 2.6 m tall on short thick legs; its trunk is a huge leather bellows #6A4A30 bound with riveted iron hoops #4A4A4E, a brass nozzle #8A7A3A on its chest; its arms are two iron levers that push and pull to work the bellows; blasts foes back with gusts from its nozzle; identifying mark: the bellows in its chest swelling and collapsing as it moves.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：胸前的皮风箱与黄铜喷嘴。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the leather bellows and brass nozzle on its chest.

subject.zh: 身高约 1 米的瘦小契约魔，两足、驼背；皮色煤灰 #4A4440，脖子与手腕套着铁环，铁环之间连着一条长纸带 #D8D2C0，纸上满是划痕；手里攥着一把小锤；眼睛金黄 #C9A227；以纸带缠缚、削弱并加重施法代价；辨识：身上永远拖着那条长到地上的纸带。
subject.en: A small, thin pact fiend about 1 m tall, hunched on two legs; coal-gray skin #4A4440, iron rings on its neck and wrists joined by a long paper strip #D8D2C0 covered in scratches; it clutches a small hammer; golden eyes #C9A227; binds with the paper strip, weakens and raises the cost of casting; identifying mark: the paper strip that always trails from it to the ground.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：连着铁环的长纸带。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the long paper strip joined to its iron rings.

subject.zh: 身高约 1.9 米的斗魂，两足直立；灰黑干皮 #4A4440 包着结实的骨架，赤裸上身，缠着磨破的赤黑绷带 #5A1A16；周身伤口不愈、张着暗红 #B33A2A；双拳各缠一截铁链；以链拳连击；辨识：背上刻着五道横疤，像在数打过的场次。
subject.en: An arena spirit about 1.9 m tall on two legs; gray-black dry skin #4A4440 over a solid frame, bare-chested and wrapped in worn red-black bandages #5A1A16; unhealing wounds gape dark red #B33A2A all over it; a length of iron chain wrapped around each fist; strikes in chained flurries of punches; identifying mark: five horizontal scars across its back, as if counting its bouts.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：缠着铁链的双拳与背上五道横疤。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the chain-wrapped fists and the five scars on its back.

subject.en: An ascetic arena spirit about 1.7 m tall, gaunt on two legs; gray-white dry skin #B8B0A4, barefoot, wearing only a coarse hemp loincloth; its whole body is bound in red-black thorn vines #5A1A16 whose spikes pierce its flesh, the wounds seeping dark red #B33A2A; empty hands; lashes with thorny arms and its thorns wound whoever strikes it; identifying marks: thorns wrapped all over, eyes always closed.

extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the thorns wrapped over it and its closed eyes.

subject.zh: 高约 2.2 米、人形的灌木哨兵，两束根须当腿；躯干是缠成一束的藤与枝 #6B7F3A，肩上开着一簇簇淡白花 #C9C1A0，腰下却发黑腐烂 #4A3B2A；没有脸，头是一个合拢的大花苞；以藤臂抽打、长出藤墙封路；辨识：头顶那个合拢的花苞，攻击时绽开。
subject.en: A humanoid shrub sentinel about 2.2 m tall walking on two bundles of roots; its trunk is a bundle of twisted vines and branches #6B7F3A with clusters of pale white flowers #C9C1A0 on its shoulders but blackened rot #4A3B2A below the waist; no face, its head a closed flower bud; lashes with vine arms and grows walls of vines to block the way; identifying mark: the closed bud of a head that bursts open when it attacks.

extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the closed flower-bud head.

subject.zh: 高约 2.8 米的树灵，两条盘根当腿，细长的枝臂；躯干是一截空心的老树干，树皮灰褐 #6A5E4A，树洞里透出暗绿的光 #6B7F3A；肩头长满苔与菌 #C9C1A0，枝梢一半抽新芽一半枯死；以枝臂抽打、为草木回复；辨识：胸口一个大树洞，像一张张开的嘴。
subject.en: A tree spirit about 2.8 m tall walking on two coiled roots, with long thin branch arms; its trunk is a section of hollow old tree, gray-brown bark #6A5E4A with dark green light #6B7F3A glowing in the hollow; moss and fungus #C9C1A0 cover its shoulders, its branch tips half budding and half dead; lashes with its branches and heals the plants around it; identifying mark: a large hollow in its chest like an open mouth.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：胸口张嘴似的大树洞。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the mouth-like hollow in its chest.

subject.en: A sediment shade like a court attendant, about 1.9 m tall, its lower body trailing off into a long dark red shadow, no legs; an ancient court robe in dark red #5A1A16 and black #1C1A1A with a high stiff collar; its face is a blurred shadow with only the mouth moving; sweeps its sleeves to send out shocks and whispers foes into despair; identifying marks: it holds an empty tray in both hands, bowing.

extra.zh: 整张图的所有帧都背向镜头（朝上），看到的是背面。

subject.zh: 身高约 2.1 米的亡灵将领，两足直立；骨架灰黑 #4A4440，穿厚重的黑铁甲 #2A2828，头盔顶上一对弯成弧的大角 #5A1A16；背上插着一面赤黑长角旗，旗面只有双角纹；手持战锤；以战锤砸击、战吼鼓舞；辨识：背后高高的角旗与盔上的大角。
subject.en: An undead commander about 2.1 m tall on two legs; gray-black bones #4A4440 in heavy black iron armor #2A2828, a pair of great arching horns #5A1A16 on its helm; a tall red-black horned banner on its back bearing only a twin-horn device; it wields a war hammer; smashes with the hammer and rallies with war cries; identifying marks: the tall horned banner behind it and the great horns on its helm.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：背后的角旗与盔上大角。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the horned banner on its back and the great helm horns.

subject.zh: 宽约 1.2 米的一团若虫，几十只拳头大的无翅幼蝗挤在一起蹦跳；虫身嫩绿 #8AA050 带黑斑 #2A2A20，节缝长着白霉 #C9C1A0；团中夹着破开的卵壳；以整团扑咬、叠加毒素；辨识：整团一起起伏蹦跳，像一锅沸水。
subject.en: A heap of nymphs about 1.2 m wide, dozens of fist-sized wingless young locusts crowded together and hopping; tender green bodies #8AA050 with black spots #2A2A20 and white mold #C9C1A0 in their seams; broken egg shells among them; swarms and bites with stacking venom; identifying mark: the whole heap heaves and hops together like boiling water.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：团中破开的卵壳与嫩绿若虫。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the broken egg shells and green nymphs.

subject.zh: 高约 2.8 米的枯木人形，两条树根当腿迈步；躯干是一截焦黑的枯树 #3A3028，剥皮处露出灰白木芯 #C8C0B0；枝臂上挂着几片枯叶，裂缝里却冒出嫩绿新芽 #8AA050；以枝臂砸击，倒下后会重新长起；辨识：枯木身上零星冒出的新芽。
subject.en: A humanoid of dead wood about 2.8 m tall striding on two roots; its trunk is a charred dead tree #3A3028 with gray-white heartwood #C8C0B0 showing where the bark has peeled; a few dry leaves hang from its branch arms, yet tender green shoots #8AA050 sprout from its cracks; smashes with its branches and grows back up after falling; identifying mark: the scattered green shoots on its dead wood.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：枯木裂缝里的嫩绿新芽。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the green shoots in the dead wood.

subject.zh: 体长约 1.7 米的犬，四足；皮毛脱落了大半，裸露的皮上开满腐花 #C9C1A0，花心暗红 #8A3A3A，花间长着橄榄绿霉 #6B7F3A；肋侧烂穿一个洞，洞里伸出花茎；以腐花之口撕咬、散播病气；辨识：脖子上一圈花，像戴着花环。
subject.en: A hound about 1.7 m long on four legs; most of its fur has fallen out and rotting flowers #C9C1A0 with dark red hearts #8A3A3A bloom on its bare skin, olive-green mold #6B7F3A between them; a hole rotted through its flank sprouts flower stems; tears with its flower-choked jaws and spreads sickness; identifying mark: a ring of flowers around its neck like a garland.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：颈上花环似的一圈花。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the garland of flowers round its neck.

subject.zh: 长约 3 米的海鳗，没有腿，身体侧扁、背鳍一直连到尾；皮色暗青灰 #3A4A50，带着珊瑚礁似的灰白斑 #C8C0B0，身侧长着几丛藤壶；口裂极深，满是倒钩牙，口角挂着金褐的钱串 #C9A227；以咬住缠绞、吸取生命；辨识：身上缠着一段锈金链，口角挂着钱串。
subject.en: A sea eel about 3 m long with no legs, a flattened body and a dorsal fin running all the way to its tail; dark blue-gray skin #3A4A50 with coral-like gray-white blotches #C8C0B0 and a few clumps of barnacles on its sides; a deeply split mouth full of barbed teeth, a string of gold-brown coins #C9A227 caught at its corner; bites, coils, crushes and drains life; identifying marks: a length of rusty gold chain wrapped around it, the coin string at its mouth.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：满是倒钩牙的深口与口角钱串。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the barbed deep mouth and the coin string.

subject.zh: 宽约 1.6 米的巨蚌，靠一只粗壮的肉足挪动；双壳厚重，外壁灰褐 #6A6058 长满藤壶，内壁是珠光的淡粉白 #E8DCD8；壳口中央托着一颗拳头大的假珍珠 #F0E8E0，周围一圈细齿；以合壳夹咬、偷物；辨识：张开时壳里那颗诱人的大珠，珠下藏着一条长舌。
subject.en: A giant clam about 1.6 m wide that shuffles along on one thick muscular foot; heavy twin shells, gray-brown outside #6A6058 and crusted with barnacles, a pearly pale pink-white inside #E8DCD8; a fist-sized false pearl #F0E8E0 sits in the middle of its open mouth, ringed with fine teeth; snaps its shells on prey and steals; identifying mark: the tempting great pearl inside when it opens, with a long tongue hidden beneath.

extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the great false pearl and the ring of fine teeth.

subject.zh: 体长约 2.6 米的豺群老母，四足，腹部松垂；灰黄毛 #9A8A6A 褪得斑驳，背上的灰烬斑 #8A8580 连成大片，侧腹的门形秃斑大得露出肋骨轮廓；两耳一立一折；以长吻撕咬、嚎叫召群；辨识：折下的一只耳，嘴边的毛全白了。
subject.en: The old mother of a jackal pack, about 2.6 m long on four legs, her belly sagging; sandy-gray fur #9A8A6A faded into a patchwork, ash blotches #8A8580 merged into large patches across her back, the door-shaped bald patch on her flank so large it shows the outline of her ribs; one ear upright and one folded; tears with her long muzzle and howls to call the pack; identifying marks: the folded ear and a muzzle gone completely white.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：一立一折的耳与全白的吻。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the one folded ear and the white muzzle.

subject.zh: 高约 5 米、由成千骨头堆成的巨冢，下身是一座摊开的骨堆，上身耸起一个粗大的骸骨巨人，双臂由长骨与断枪捆成；骨色从灰黄 #C8BFA8 到焦黑 #3A3632；骨缝里插满各个年代的锈兵器；以骨臂横扫、碾压，吸附骨堆回补；辨识：胸口一圈头骨围成的空腔里亮着暗红光 #B33A2A。
subject.en: A huge barrow about 5 m tall heaped from thousands of bones, its lower half a sprawling pile of bones and its upper half a hulking skeletal giant rising from it, its arms bundled from long bones and broken spears; bones ranging from grayish yellow #C8BFA8 to charred black #3A3632; rusted weapons of every era stuck in the gaps; sweeps with bony arms, crushes, and pulls in bone piles to mend itself; identifying mark: a dark red glow #B33A2A inside a hollow ringed by skulls in its chest.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：头骨围成的胸腔与暗红光。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the skull-ringed chest hollow and its red glow.

subject.zh: 高约 4.5 米、占满一间灶屋的澱聚体，佝偻的人形，背上驮着半间屋的残墙与灶台；身体是灰黑澱 #4D4A52 与灶灰 #8A8580，墙砖、锅碗、门框残片嵌在身上；胸前一口灶膛透出淡紫的火 #C6B5E0；以长臂横扫、震荡；辨识：背上那截带门框的残墙与胸前的灶膛。
subject.en: A sediment mass about 4.5 m tall that fills a whole kitchen, a hunched humanoid carrying half a house of broken walls and a hearth on its back; its body is gray-black sediment #4D4A52 and hearth ash #8A8580 with bricks, pots, bowls and door-frame fragments embedded in it; a fire of pale lavender #C6B5E0 shows through a hearth mouth in its chest; sweeps with long arms and sends out shocks; identifying marks: the broken wall with a door frame on its back and the hearth in its chest.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：背上带门框的残墙与胸前灶膛。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the walled door frame on its back and the hearth in its chest.

subject.en: A giant white maggot about 5 m long with no legs, a fat body with neat segment lines; porcelain-white skin #EDE8DC with pale gold seams #D8C27A, its markings perfectly symmetrical; a row of small mouths along its flank keeps spitting out maggots; a round mouth at its head ringed with fine teeth, pale blue #9DB4C8 inside; crushes and spews sickness; identifying marks: a few pale bone fragments and an old seal strip stuck on its back.

subject.zh: 高约 4.5 米的一团回音，没有固定形体，由上百张翻飞的书页与几十个模糊的学者人影旋成一座漏斗；纸页羊皮纸色 #D8D2C0，人影墨蓝灰 #2B2B3A，漏斗中心是一张淡紫的讲台轮廓 #7A6A9A；以纸页风暴、复诵令人失语；辨识：漏斗中央那张空讲台。
subject.en: An echo about 4.5 m tall with no fixed shape, a funnel whirled from hundreds of flying pages and dozens of blurred scholar figures; parchment-colored pages #D8D2C0, ink blue-gray figures #2B2B3A, and at the funnel's heart the pale violet outline of a lectern #7A6A9A; attacks with page storms and repeats itself until foes fall silent; identifying mark: the empty lectern at the center of the funnel.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：漏斗中央的空讲台。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the empty lectern at the center of the funnel.

subject.zh: 高约 3 米的骸骨将领，两足直立、肩宽如门；骨色焦黄 #B8A888，层层叠着不同时代的甲，最外是一副赭红将官板甲 #8A4A30；背上驮着一只铁烽火盆，盆里燃着暗红余烬 #B33A2A；以重斧劈砍、点燃烽火召兵；辨识：背上的烽火盆与盔上的赭红长缨。
subject.en: A skeletal commander about 3 m tall on two legs, shoulders as wide as a door; scorched yellow bones #B8A888 under layer upon layer of armor from many eras, an ochre-red officer's plate #8A4A30 outermost; an iron beacon brazier on its back with dark red embers #B33A2A burning inside; hews with a heavy axe and lights its beacon to call troops; identifying marks: the beacon brazier on its back and the long ochre-red plume on its helm.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：背上的烽火盆与赭红长缨。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the beacon brazier and the ochre-red plume.

subject.zh: 高约 4 米的一座宝窟，由几十只宝箱、钱匣与账柜挤在一起长成；木箱暗褐 #5A4028，包铜发绿 #8A7A3A，箱盖一张张开合如嘴，舌头暗红 #8A2A2A；缝隙里塞满金褐的钱 #C9A227 与焦黑账页；顶上最大的钱匣是它的头；以众箱合盖夹咬、吸走钱；辨识：钱匣头上一把巨大的锁。
subject.en: A hoard about 4 m tall grown from dozens of chests, coin boxes and ledger cabinets crowded together; dark brown wood #5A4028 with verdigris copper fittings #8A7A3A, lid after lid snapping open and shut like mouths with dark red tongues #8A2A2A; gold-brown coins #C9A227 and charred ledger pages stuffed in every gap; the largest coin box on top is its head; bites with all its lids and draws in coins; identifying mark: a huge padlock on its coin-box head.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：钱匣头上的巨锁。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the huge padlock on its coin-box head.

subject.zh: 高约 5 米的渣堆巨形，下身是一座坍塌的炉渣山，上身耸起粗大的渣臂；渣皮黑灰 #3A3634 夹着锈铁 #6A4A3A，裂缝透出橙红热光 #C8682A；胸腔里一颗搏动的熔渣心，亮得发黄 #E09A3A；渣缝里卡满焦黑纸片；以渣臂砸地、灼烫；辨识：胸口那颗一胀一缩的熔渣心。
subject.en: A slag-heap giant about 5 m tall, its lower half a collapsing mountain of slag and its upper half rising into massive slag arms; black-gray slag crust #3A3634 mixed with rusty iron #6A4A3A, orange-red heat #C8682A glowing through the cracks; a throbbing heart of molten slag glowing yellow #E09A3A in its chest; charred scraps of paper wedged in its crevices; slams with slag arms and scorches; identifying mark: the molten heart in its chest swelling and shrinking.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：胸口一胀一缩的熔渣心。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the swelling and shrinking molten heart.

subject.zh: 高约 5 米的渣堆巨形，下身是一座坍塌的炉渣山，上身耸起粗大的渣臂；渣皮黑灰 #3A3634 夹着锈铁 #6A4A3A，裂缝透出橙红热光 #C8682A；胸腔里一颗搏动的熔渣心，亮得发黄 #E09A3A；渣缝里卡满焦黑纸片；以渣臂砸地、灼烫；辨识：胸口那颗一胀一缩的熔渣心。
subject.en: A slag-heap giant about 5 m tall, its lower half a collapsing mountain of slag and its upper half rising into massive slag arms; black-gray slag crust #3A3634 mixed with rusty iron #6A4A3A, orange-red heat #C8682A glowing through the cracks; a throbbing heart of molten slag glowing yellow #E09A3A in its chest; charred scraps of paper wedged in its crevices; slams with slag arms and scorches; identifying mark: the molten heart in its chest swelling and shrinking.

subject.zh: 高约 4 米、扎根不动的巨型菌团，像一座长满伞菌的小丘；菌伞层层叠叠，灰白 #C9C1A0 带橄榄绿霉 #6B7F3A，丘底露出几副鹿骨与兽骨；顶上一朵最大的伞菌像王冠；菌褶里不停飘出孢粉；以孢爆致病、长出菌傀；辨识：丘顶王冠般的巨伞菌，伞下吊着一只鹿头骨。
subject.en: A giant fungal mass about 4 m tall rooted in place, like a hillock crowded with mushrooms; layer upon layer of gray-white caps #C9C1A0 with olive-green mold #6B7F3A, deer and beast bones showing at its base; the largest mushroom on top is like a crown; spore dust keeps drifting from its gills; bursts spores to sicken and grows new fungal husks; identifying mark: the crown-like giant cap on top with a deer skull hanging beneath it.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：丘顶王冠般的巨伞菌与鹿头骨。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the crown-like giant cap and the deer skull.

subject.zh: 宽约 5 米、扎根不动的一座卵坡，由泥土与成千卵囊堆成的鼓包；卵囊枯黄 #C9C1A0 带橄榄绿脉纹 #6B7F3A，一颗颗半埋在暗褐土里 #4A3B2A；坡顶伏着一只巨大的雌蝗躯干，翅膀残破，腹部连着卵堆；以卵囊爆裂、放出蝗群；辨识：坡顶半埋的巨蝗与不停鼓动的卵囊。
subject.en: A mound about 5 m wide rooted in place, a swelling of earth and thousands of egg pods; dry yellow pods #C9C1A0 with olive-green veins #6B7F3A half buried in dark brown soil #4A3B2A; the body of a giant female locust lies on top with ragged wings, her abdomen joined to the egg heap; bursts its pods and releases swarms; identifying marks: the half-buried giant locust on top and the constantly pulsing egg pods.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：坡顶半埋的巨蝗。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the half-buried giant locust on top.

subject.zh: 高约 4.5 米的巨型渊胎，形体更不全：一边是数条粗臂，另一边是不断鼓起的胎囊，囊里隐约蜷着几个小渊胎；表皮暗红 #5A1A16 与黑 #1C1A1A，裂纹透出赤红 #B33A2A；头顶一圈歪斜的角芽；以粗臂横扫、冲撞；辨识：身侧那个透出小渊胎轮廓的大胎囊。
subject.en: A giant unfinished spawn about 4.5 m tall with an even less complete form: several thick arms on one side and a constantly swelling sac on the other, a few small spawn faintly curled inside it; dark red #5A1A16 and black #1C1A1A skin with red #B33A2A in the cracks; a ring of crooked horn buds on its head; sweeps with its arms and rams; identifying mark: the great sac on its side with the outlines of small spawn inside.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：身侧透出小渊胎轮廓的胎囊。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the sac on its side with small spawn inside.

subject.zh: 长约 5 米、由一整张龙蜕凝成的巢形魔物，像一条盘起的空皮，四肢只剩空空的皮爪；蜕皮冰蓝灰 #8A9AA8，鳞缘泛银 #D0D8E0，里面是空的，破处透得见背后；头是空蜕的龙首，眼窝里两点橙红火光 #D86A2A；以空爪撕扯、吐出火星；辨识：盘起的空皮里窝着几只鳞生蜥。
subject.en: A nest-like monster about 5 m long congealed from an entire dragon slough, like a coiled empty skin whose limbs are only hollow skin claws; ice blue-gray slough #8A9AA8 with silvery scale edges #D0D8E0, empty inside, so you can see through its torn places; its head is the hollow dragon head of the slough with two orange-red flames #D86A2A in the eye sockets; tears with its empty claws and spits sparks; identifying mark: a few scaleborn lizards nesting in the coils of the empty skin.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：空蜕龙首眼窝里的火光。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the flames in the eye sockets of the hollow head.

subject.zh: 体长约 2 米的老灰狼，四足；灰毛 #7A7C7E 夹着大片灰斑，背脊长出一排赤黑短棘 #5A1A16；嘴边一圈白霜结成的硬须 #E0E8F0，四季不化；几处旧伤张着不合 #B33A2A；以獠牙撕咬、长嚎召群；辨识：嘴边那圈不化的霜须。
subject.en: An old gray wolf about 2 m long on four legs; gray fur #7A7C7E with large gray blotches, a row of short red-black spikes #5A1A16 along its spine; a ring of stiff whiskers of white frost #E0E8F0 around its muzzle that never melts in any season; a few old wounds that never close #B33A2A; tears with its fangs and howls to call the pack; identifying mark: the never-melting frost beard around its muzzle.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：嘴边不化的霜须。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the never-melting frost beard.

subject.zh: 身高约 1.8 米的亡灵骑士，两足直立，覆着薄霜；脸完整安详、像瓷像 #EDE8DC，伤口却淌着暗红冻血 #B33A2A；穿旧式北境骑士锁甲与蓝灰罩袍 #6A7A8A，腰佩长剑；左手提一盏铁马灯，灯光暖黄 #E0B860；以长剑劈砍；辨识：手里的马灯与低头行礼的姿势。
subject.en: An undead knight about 1.8 m tall on two legs, glazed with thin frost; a whole, serene face like a porcelain statue #EDE8DC, yet its wounds run with dark red frozen blood #B33A2A; old-style northern knight's mail and a blue-gray surcoat #6A7A8A, a longsword at its hip; an iron lantern in its left hand with warm yellow light #E0B860; slashes with the longsword; identifying marks: the lantern in its hand and its bowed, saluting pose.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：手提的铁马灯。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the iron lantern in its hand.

subject.zh: 体长约 0.7 米的老白鼠，四足，比同类大一圈、胖得发圆；毛色瓷白 #EDE8DC，左右花纹完全对称，背脊的淡金线 #D8C27A 宽得像一条披带；眼是淡蓝瓷珠 #9DB4C8；以门齿咬、召来瓷眼鼠；辨识：头顶一圈小冠似的瓷质骨突，坐着时前爪交叠在胸前。
subject.en: An old white rat about 0.7 m long on four legs, a size bigger than its kind and round with fat; porcelain-white fur #EDE8DC with perfectly symmetrical markings, the pale gold line #D8C27A down its spine as broad as a stole; pale blue porcelain-bead eyes #9DB4C8; bites with its incisors and calls porcelain-eyed rats; identifying marks: a little crown of porcelain bone knobs on its head, forepaws folded at its chest when it sits.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：头顶小冠似的瓷质骨突。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the little crown of porcelain knobs on its head.

subject.zh: 高约 2.6 米、细长的人形灰影，比同类高出一截；身体是层层剥落的灰烬薄片 #8A8580 与暗灰 #4D4A52，胸口一个门形空洞；一只手总举在嘴边，像在吹口哨，另一只手拄着一根弯头的长灰杖；不主动伤人，只会扬灰；辨识：吹口哨的手势与那根牧羊杖似的弯头杖。
subject.en: A tall, thin humanoid ash shade about 2.6 m high, a head taller than its kind; its body is layers of peeling ash flakes #8A8580 and dark gray #4D4A52, a door-shaped hole in its chest; one hand is always raised to its mouth as if whistling, the other leaning on a long crook-headed staff of ash; never harms first and only flings ash; identifying marks: the whistling gesture and the shepherd-crook staff.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：举到嘴边吹哨的手与弯头杖。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the whistling hand and the crook-headed staff.

subject.zh: 身高约 1.6 米的女亡灵，两足、步子很轻；全身像被一层烟灰色玻璃 #6E6A72 封住，玻璃下是灰烬色的身形 #8A8580；穿千年前式样的长裙，头戴一圈花环，花瓣封在玻璃里泛淡紫 #C6B5E0；以冰冷的手触碰、玻璃反光晃眼；辨识：头上的花环与左手无名指的一枚戒指。
subject.en: A female undead about 1.6 m tall moving lightly on two legs; her whole body seems sealed under a layer of smoke-gray glass #6E6A72 with an ash-colored figure #8A8580 beneath; she wears a long dress of a style a thousand years old and a garland on her head, its petals sealed in the glass and tinged pale lavender #C6B5E0; touches with cold hands and dazzles with glints off the glass; identifying marks: the garland on her head and a ring on her left ring finger.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：玻璃封住的花环与戒指。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the glass-sealed garland and the ring.

subject.en: A female undead about 1.6 m tall moving lightly on two legs; her whole body seems sealed under a layer of smoke-gray glass #6E6A72 with an ash-colored figure #8A8580 beneath; she wears a long dress of a style a thousand years old and a garland on her head, its petals sealed in the glass and tinged pale lavender #C6B5E0; touches with cold hands and dazzles with glints off the glass; identifying marks: the garland on her head and a ring on her left ring finger.

subject.zh: 身高约 1.7 米的信使亡灵，两足，总在奔跑；全身灰烬色 #8A8580，穿千年前式样的短外衣与绑腿 #6A6258，头戴一顶压扁的软帽；斜挎一只鼓鼓的皮信囊 #6A5038，囊口露出几封信；被堵住才用拳头反击；辨识：前倾奔跑的姿势与身侧的大信囊。
subject.en: An undead courier about 1.7 m tall on two legs, always running; ash-colored all over #8A8580, in a short coat and leg wraps #6A6258 of a style a thousand years old and a squashed soft cap; a bulging leather letter bag #6A5038 slung across its body with a few letters poking out; only hits back with its fists when cornered; identifying marks: its forward-leaning run and the big letter bag at its side.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：前倾奔跑的姿势与大信囊。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the forward-leaning run and the big letter bag.

subject.zh: 身高约 1.8 米的拾门者亡灵，两足直立、背更驼；干枯灰皮 #8A8580，穿锈蚀鳞甲与褪色白罩袍 #D8D2C0；双手握一把长柄铁铲 #6A6A68，铲柄上烙着一个焦黑的十字形圣印；指节磨穿、露着骨；以铁铲劈砸、震退；辨识：那把烙着十字圣印、铲面磨得发亮的铁铲。
subject.en: A gatepicker undead about 1.8 m tall on two legs, more stooped than its kind; dry gray hide #8A8580, rusted scale armor and a faded white surcoat #D8D2C0; it grips a long-handled iron shovel #6A6A68 with a charred cross-shaped holy seal burnt into the handle; knuckles worn through to the bone; hacks with the shovel and knocks foes back; identifying mark: the shovel with the cross seal on its handle and a blade worn shiny.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：烙着十字圣印的铁铲。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the shovel with the cross seal burnt into its handle.

subject.zh: 高约 3 米、勉强像人的一大团灰澱，两条粗腿撑着；身体灰黑 #4D4A52，表面嵌满几百盏大大小小的油灯与门灯，灯罩铜绿 #6A8A6A、灯火暖黄 #E0B860，明灭不定；头部是一团挂满灯的灰；以灯爆震荡、召来磷火；辨识：满身嵌着的灯，远看像一整条亮灯的街。
subject.en: A great barely human mass of gray sediment about 3 m tall standing on two thick legs; gray-black body #4D4A52 studded with hundreds of oil lamps and door lamps of every size, verdigris shades #6A8A6A and warm yellow flames #E0B860 flickering on and off; its head is a lump of ash hung with lamps; sends out bursts of lamplight and summons wisp fires; identifying mark: the lamps all over its body, like a whole street lit up from afar.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：满身嵌着的油灯与门灯。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the oil lamps and door lamps all over it.

subject.zh: 身高约 1.7 米的凿碑匠亡灵，两足、弓背；灰白干皮 #B8B0A4，穿古旧白祭司袍，袍边淡金纹 #D8C27A，系皮围裙；右手高举铁锤，始终不落下，左手的凿子垂在身侧；脸朝一侧低着；以锤柄击打、凿声令人失声；辨识：那只高高举起、停在半空的锤子。
subject.en: An undead stele carver about 1.7 m tall, stooped on two legs; gray-white dry skin #B8B0A4, an old white priest's robe with pale gold trim #D8C27A and a leather apron; its right hand holds an iron hammer raised high and never brings it down, the chisel in its left hand hanging at its side; its face turned down to one side; strikes with the hammer haft and its chiselling strikes silence; identifying mark: the hammer held high and stopped in midair.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：停在半空的铁锤。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the hammer stopped in midair.

subject.en: An undead stele carver about 1.7 m tall, stooped on two legs; gray-white dry skin #B8B0A4, an old white priest's robe with pale gold trim #D8C27A and a leather apron; its right hand holds an iron hammer raised high and never brings it down, the chisel in its left hand hanging at its side; its face turned down to one side; strikes with the hammer haft and its chiselling strikes silence; identifying mark: the hammer held high and stopped in midair.

subject.zh: 体长约 1.9 米的瓷骨猎犬，四足修长，比同类更瘦更长；全身上釉的瓷白 #EDE8DC 光滑得几乎没有裂纹，只有脊背一道淡蓝细裂 #9DB4C8；头部光滑，空瓷孔的眼里透出淡金 #D8C27A；以瓷牙扑咬、伏击；辨识：通体瓷白，连腹下与脚掌都几乎没有暗面。
subject.en: A porcelain hound about 1.9 m long on long slender legs, leaner and longer than its kind; its whole glazed porcelain-white body #EDE8DC is so smooth it has almost no cracks, only one thin pale blue crack #9DB4C8 along its spine; a smooth head, pale gold #D8C27A showing in its empty porcelain eye holes; bites with porcelain teeth and strikes from ambush; identifying mark: porcelain white all over, with hardly any shaded side even on its belly and paws.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：脊背那道淡蓝细裂。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the single thin pale blue crack along its spine.

subject.zh: 高约 1.8 米、苍白的人影，由无数白蛆聚成，远看像一个低头走路的人；表面瓷白 #EDE8DC，细看是一条条对称排列的蛆，节缝泛淡金 #D8C27A；双手空着垂在身前；脸是一团光滑的白；以伸出的蛆手吸取生气、为同伴回复；辨识：走路时脚下不断掉落又爬回的白蛆。
subject.en: A pale human figure about 1.8 m tall made of countless white maggots, from afar like a person walking with head bowed; porcelain-white surface #EDE8DC that up close is row upon row of symmetrically arranged maggots with pale gold seams #D8C27A; empty hands hanging in front of it; its face a smooth blank white; drains vitality with outstretched maggot hands and restores its allies; identifying mark: maggots that keep dropping from its feet and crawling back as it walks.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：光滑空白的脸与脚下掉落的白蛆。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the smooth blank face and the maggots dropping from its feet.

subject.en: An undead officer about 1.9 m tall whose lower body becomes gray-red wisps, no legs; old-style officer's mail and a long ochre-red cloak #8A4A30, an iron helm #6A6A68 with a faded plume; an ashen face #B8B0A4 with a thick beard; a roll-call board under his left arm and a command baton in his right hand; directs with the baton and shouts to call troops; identifying marks: the roll-call board under his arm and the faded plume on his helm.

subject.zh: 高约 1.7 米的少年学者幽灵，下半身散成一叠纸页，没有腿；穿墨蓝灰学袍 #2B2B3A，皮色羊皮纸白 #D8D2C0；双手捧着一本只翻开第一页的书，那页纸泛着淡紫 #7A6A9A；嘴停在说到一半的样子；以纸页割伤、复诵令人失语；辨识：永远只翻在第一页的书。

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：只翻开第一页的书。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the book open only at its first page.

subject.zh: 体长约 2.4 米的斗场角蜥，四足外撇、长尾，比同类魁梧；鳞片赤褐 #7A3A2A，背上骨板黑 #1C1A1A；鼻端三角中的主角又粗又长，角尖套着一只磨亮的铜角鞘 #B08A4A；脖子上还挂着半截斗场的铁链；以角冲撞，只攻击持兵器的人；辨识：铜角鞘与颈上的断链。
subject.en: An arena horned lizard about 2.4 m long with sprawling legs and a long tail, burlier than its kind; red-brown scales #7A3A2A and black dorsal plates #1C1A1A; the main horn of the three on its snout is long and thick, its tip capped with a polished brass sheath #B08A4A; half an arena chain still hangs from its neck; rams with its horn and attacks only those who carry weapons; identifying marks: the brass horn sheath and the broken chain at its neck.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：铜角鞘与颈上断链。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the brass horn sheath and the broken neck chain.

subject.zh: 长约 2.2 米、悬在离地一米处的一柄巨大白刃，没有柄，刃根是一道齐整的断口；刃身瓷白 #EDE8DC、两面对称，中段一道永远张开的长红口 #B33A2A；刃周缠着赤黑的烟 #5A1A16；以刃身劈旋、召来锋灵；辨识：刃根齐整的断口，比普通锋灵大一截，红口更长。
subject.en: A huge white blade about 2.2 m long hanging a meter above the ground with no hilt, its base a clean break; porcelain-white steel #EDE8DC, symmetrical on both faces, with a long red gash #B33A2A across its middle that never closes; red-black smoke #5A1A16 winds around it; slashes and spins and calls blade wisps; identifying marks: the clean break at its base, larger than an ordinary blade wisp, with a longer red gash.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：刃根齐整的断口与长红口。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the clean break at the base and the long red gash.

subject.zh: 体长约 0.7 米的老钱袋鼠，四足，胖得发圆；毛色金褐 #C9A227 夹着灰白，腹下的钱袋皮囊大得拖地；两只前爪各捏着一枚铜钱，像在称；胡须长而翘；以门齿咬、吸走掉落的钱、召来钱袋鼠；辨识：尾巴卷成秤钩，挂着一只小铜秤盘 #B08A4A。
subject.en: An old purse mouse about 0.7 m long on four legs, round with fat; gold-brown fur #C9A227 grizzled with gray-white, the purse pouch under its belly so big it drags on the ground; it pinches a copper coin in each forepaw as if weighing them; long upturned whiskers; bites, draws in dropped coins and calls purse mice; identifying mark: its tail curled into a scale hook with a small brass scale pan #B08A4A hanging from it.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：卷成秤钩的尾巴与小秤盘。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the scale-hook tail and the small scale pan.

subject.en: An old purse mouse about 0.7 m long on four legs, round with fat; gold-brown fur #C9A227 grizzled with gray-white, the purse pouch under its belly so big it drags on the ground; it pinches a copper coin in each forepaw as if weighing them; long upturned whiskers; bites, draws in dropped coins and calls purse mice; identifying mark: its tail curled into a scale hook with a small brass scale pan #B08A4A hanging from it.

extra.zh: 整张图的所有帧都背向镜头（朝上），看到的是背面。
extra.en: Every frame in this sheet faces away from the viewer (up), showing the back.

subject.zh: 体长约 2.6 米的巨型吞金蟾，四足蹲伏，胖得几乎摊开；疙瘩皮暗绿 #3A5A40，背上的铜钉疙瘩 #C9A227 连成片；喉囊巨大鼓胀，透出里面成堆的圆钱与一枚印戒的轮廓；眼金黄凸出；以长舌卷吞、吞人数秒、喷毒；辨识：喉囊里那枚戒指的影子与嘴角挂着的钱串。
subject.en: A giant coin-gulping toad about 2.6 m long squatting on four legs, so fat it nearly spreads flat; warty dark green skin #3A5A40, the copper-stud warts #C9A227 on its back merged into patches; a huge bulging throat sac showing piles of round coins and the outline of a signet ring inside; bulging golden eyes; snatches with its long tongue, swallows victims for a few seconds and squirts venom; identifying marks: the shadow of the ring in its throat sac and a string of coins hanging from the corner of its mouth.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：喉囊里的戒指影子。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the ring shadow in its throat sac.

subject.zh: 宽约 1.6 米的旧账柜，柜门就是嘴，底下生出四条细长的木腿；木料暗褐 #5A4028，包铜发绿 #8A7A3A，柜门一圈尖木牙，舌头暗红 #8A2A2A；柜顶摆着一把算盘，算珠自己拨动；两只抽屉像眼睛；以合门夹咬、吸走钱；辨识：柜顶自己拨动的算盘。
subject.en: An old ledger cabinet about 1.6 m wide whose doors are its mouth, with four long thin wooden legs beneath; dark brown wood #5A4028 with verdigris copper fittings #8A7A3A, a ring of sharp wooden teeth along its doors and a dark red tongue #8A2A2A; an abacus sits on top, its beads clicking by themselves; two drawers like eyes; snaps its doors on prey and draws in coins; identifying mark: the self-moving abacus on its top.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：柜顶自己拨动的算盘。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the self-moving abacus on its top.

subject.zh: 身高约 1.8 米的溺死港务官，两足；泡胀的皮肉青绿 #4A6A5A，穿古旧的深蓝港务官长衣 #2A3A50，挂着海草；颈上一条粗金链，链牌刻着门形图样 #C9A227；双手提着一口长满藤壶的旧港钟；以摇钟震荡、召来溺金者；辨识：手里那口长满藤壶的钟与颈上的金链牌。
subject.en: A drowned harbor master about 1.8 m tall on two legs; bloated blue-green flesh #4A6A5A, an old deep blue harbor master's coat #2A3A50 hung with seaweed; a heavy gold chain at his neck with a plate stamped with a door shape #C9A227; he carries an old harbor bell crusted with barnacles in both hands; rings the bell to send out shock waves and calls the gilded drowned; identifying marks: the barnacled bell in his hands and the gold chain plate at his neck.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：长满藤壶的港钟与金链牌。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the barnacled harbor bell and the gold chain plate.

subject.zh: 人立高约 4.5 米的巨熊，四足；深褐毛 #4A3B2A 几乎被背上厚厚的苔与蕨盖满 #6B7F3A，像一座小山，苔里开着白花 #C9C1A0，还长着几棵小树苗；肩上的木刺粗如树枝；眼睛浑浊而温和；以巨掌拍击、背刺扎伤；辨识：背上那几棵小树苗。
subject.en: A huge bear about 4.5 m tall when rearing, four legs; its dark brown fur #4A3B2A is almost buried under the thick moss and ferns #6B7F3A on its back, like a small hill, white flowers #C9C1A0 blooming in the moss and a few young saplings growing there; the woody spikes on its shoulders are as thick as branches; cloudy, gentle eyes; swipes with huge paws and pricks with the spikes on its back; identifying mark: the young saplings on its back.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：背上长着的小树苗。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the young saplings growing on its back.

subject.zh: 人立高约 4.5 米的巨熊，四足；深褐毛 #4A3B2A 几乎被背上厚厚的苔与蕨盖满 #6B7F3A，像一座小山，苔里开着白花 #C9C1A0，还长着几棵小树苗；肩上的木刺粗如树枝；眼睛浑浊而温和；以巨掌拍击、背刺扎伤；辨识：背上那几棵小树苗。
subject.en: A huge bear about 4.5 m tall when rearing, four legs; its dark brown fur #4A3B2A is almost buried under the thick moss and ferns #6B7F3A on its back, like a small hill, white flowers #C9C1A0 blooming in the moss and a few young saplings growing there; the woody spikes on its shoulders are as thick as branches; cloudy, gentle eyes; swipes with huge paws and pricks with the spikes on its back; identifying mark: the young saplings on its back.

extra.zh: 整张图的所有帧都背向镜头（朝上），看到的是背面。
extra.en: Every frame in this sheet faces away from the viewer (up), showing the back.

subject.zh: 直径约 1.8 米的一团疯长藤，藤蔓却出奇整齐，盘成一个圆圆的灌木球；藤色橄榄绿 #6B7F3A，球面开着排成行的淡白小花 #C9C1A0，底部烂成黑褐 #4A3B2A；伸出两根带刺长藤，末端弯成剪刀似的钩；以藤钩钳夹、缠绕；辨识：修剪般整齐的球形与那对剪刀钩。
subject.en: A mass of rampant vines about 1.8 m across, yet strangely tidy, coiled into a neat round shrub ball; olive-green vines #6B7F3A with rows of small pale white flowers #C9C1A0 on its surface and black-brown rot #4A3B2A at its base; two long thorny vines reach out, their ends curled into shear-like hooks; clips and entangles with its hooks; identifying marks: the neatly trimmed round shape and the pair of shear hooks.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：修剪整齐的球形与剪刀钩。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the trimmed round shape and the shear hooks.

subject.zh: 身长约 6 米的巨型蝗蜕，六条节腿、背上一对残破的巨翅；蜕壳枯黄 #C9C1A0，层层叠叠像年轮，节缝发黑 #4A3B2A，满身橄榄绿霉斑 #6B7F3A；背上的裂缝里涌出蝗群；复眼空洞；以前足钩扑、枯萎之息攻击；辨识：蜕壳上一圈圈年轮似的层纹。
subject.en: A giant locust husk about 6 m long with six jointed legs and a pair of ragged great wings on its back; dry yellowed shell #C9C1A0 in layer upon layer like tree rings, blackened seams #4A3B2A, olive-green mildew #6B7F3A all over; locust swarms pour from the split in its back; empty compound eyes; hooks with its forelegs and breathes withering air; identifying mark: the ring-like layers on its husk.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：蜕壳上年轮似的层纹。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the tree-ring layers on its husk.

subject.zh: 肩高约 2 米的野角兽，四足粗壮；长毛黄褐 #9A7A4A，肩颈的毛长而深 #5A4428；头上一对向前弯的粗角通体雪白 #F0F0EC，像打磨过的象牙；额头一撮白毛；身上几处旧伤张着暗红 #B33A2A；以白角冲撞、击退；辨识：一对雪白的大角，在草原上远远就能看见。
subject.en: A wild hornbeast about 2 m at the shoulder on thick legs; long tawny-brown fur #9A7A4A, longer and darker on its shoulders and neck #5A4428; a pair of thick forward-curving horns pure snow white #F0F0EC like polished ivory; a tuft of white hair on its brow; a few old wounds gape dark red #B33A2A; rams with its white horns and knocks foes back; identifying mark: the pair of snow-white horns, visible from far across the steppe.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：一对雪白的大角。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the pair of snow-white horns.

subject.zh: 宽约 6 米的巨大蝗群，上千只蝗虫翻成一座移动的黄褐云山；虫身枯黄 #C9C1A0 带橄榄绿条纹 #6B7F3A，云团最密处发黑 #4A3B2A；云中央隐约有一只巨大蝗后的轮廓，翅展开如帆；以整群扑盖、啃食、拖慢敌人；辨识：云团中央那对帆一样的大翅。
subject.en: An enormous locust swarm about 6 m wide, thousands of locusts tumbling into a moving yellow-brown mountain of cloud; dry yellow bodies #C9C1A0 striped with olive green #6B7F3A, darkening to black #4A3B2A where the cloud is densest; the outline of a giant locust queen looms at its center, her wings spread like sails; smothers, devours and slows its foes; identifying mark: the pair of sail-like great wings at the heart of the cloud.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：云团中央帆一样的大翅。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the sail-like wings at the heart of the cloud.

subject.zh: 高约 1.6 米的老祭司游魂，下半身散成青灰烟缕，没有腿；佝偻，披着厚重的赭红毡袍 #8A3A2A 与层层兽骨饰，灰白脸上一对尖兽耳，满脸皱纹；手拄一根挂着铃铛的骨杖；嘴总张着在骂人；以骨杖敲击、威吓；辨识：颈上的祖灵念珠与骨杖上一圈小铃。
subject.en: The ghost of an old shaman woman about 1.6 m tall whose lower body dissolves into blue-gray wisps, no legs; stooped under a heavy ochre-red felt robe #8A3A2A and layers of bone ornaments, a wrinkled gray-white face with a pair of pointed animal ears; she leans on a bone staff hung with bells; her mouth is always open in a scolding; strikes with the staff and intimidates; identifying marks: the ancestor prayer beads at her neck and the ring of small bells on her staff.

subject.zh: 高约 1.6 米的老祭司游魂，下半身散成青灰烟缕，没有腿；佝偻，披着厚重的赭红毡袍 #8A3A2A 与层层兽骨饰，灰白脸上一对尖兽耳，满脸皱纹；手拄一根挂着铃铛的骨杖；嘴总张着在骂人；以骨杖敲击、威吓；辨识：颈上的祖灵念珠与骨杖上一圈小铃。
subject.en: The ghost of an old shaman woman about 1.6 m tall whose lower body dissolves into blue-gray wisps, no legs; stooped under a heavy ochre-red felt robe #8A3A2A and layers of bone ornaments, a wrinkled gray-white face with a pair of pointed animal ears; she leans on a bone staff hung with bells; her mouth is always open in a scolding; strikes with the staff and intimidates; identifying marks: the ancestor prayer beads at her neck and the ring of small bells on her staff.

subject.zh: 体长约 2.2 米的老魔狼，四足；黑灰毛 #2A2828 掺着大片霜白，背上还套着一副小号旧鞍的残骸，鞍环断了一只 #8A7A60；赤黑硬鬃 #5A1A16 结着冰碴，额上短角磨钝；眼神安静；以獠牙撕咬、带霜扑击；辨识：背上残留的小号旧鞍与断掉的鞍环。
subject.en: An old warg about 2.2 m long on four legs; black-gray fur #2A2828 shot through with frosty white, the remains of a small old saddle still strapped to its back with one saddle ring broken #8A7A60; its red-black crest #5A1A16 crusted with ice, its brow horns worn blunt; quiet eyes; tears with its fangs and pounces with frost; identifying marks: the small old saddle on its back and the broken saddle ring.

extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the small old saddle and the broken ring.

subject.zh: 高约 2 米、没长完的澱生体，一侧是粗臂，一侧是鼓动的澱块；表皮暗红 #5A1A16 与黑 #1C1A1A，裂纹透出赤红 #B33A2A；头部左半边长出半张清晰的人脸，五官端正、神情茫然，右半边仍是一团角芽；以畸形的臂横扫、震慑；辨识：头上那半张人脸。
subject.en: An unfinished sediment creature about 2 m tall, a thick arm on one side and a pulsing lump of sediment on the other; dark red #5A1A16 and black #1C1A1A skin with red #B33A2A in the cracks; the left half of its head has grown half of a clear human face, well-featured and bewildered, while the right half is still a clump of horn buds; sweeps with its misshapen arm and terrifies; identifying mark: the half human face on its head.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：头上那半张人脸。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the half human face on its head.

subject.zh: 身高约 1.9 米的亡灵斗士，两足直立、站姿笔挺；灰白干皮 #B8B0A4，光着上身，腰间系着近百条细绶带，层层叠叠垂成一条短裙，颜色各异；胸前一道致命旧伤 #B33A2A；双手持一柄缺口弯刀；以弯刀连斩；辨识：腰间那一大把各色绶带。
subject.en: An undead duelist about 1.9 m tall standing ramrod straight on two legs; gray-white dry skin #B8B0A4, bare-chested, with nearly a hundred thin sashes of many colors tied at its waist, layered into a short skirt; an old mortal wound across its chest #B33A2A; holds a notched curved blade in both hands; strikes in rapid cuts; identifying mark: the great bundle of many-colored sashes at its waist.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：腰间成把的各色绶带。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the bundle of many-colored sashes at its waist.

subject.zh: 体长约 1.7 米的老狼，四足，常趴卧；毛色淡得发白 #D8D8D0，毛尖带一点瓷光，眼角却是红的 #B33A2A，像刚哭过；脖子上一只旧皮项圈，挂着一枚刻有盾徽的铜牌 #B08A4A；平时不动，被惹怒才带霜扑咬；辨识：发白的毛、红眼角与项圈上的盾徽。
subject.en: An old wolf about 1.7 m long on four legs, usually lying down; its fur so pale it is almost white #D8D8D0, the tips with a slight porcelain sheen, yet the corners of its eyes are red #B33A2A as if it had just been weeping; an old leather collar round its neck with a brass tag stamped with a shield emblem #B08A4A; it stays still unless provoked, then pounces with frost; identifying marks: the whitened fur, the red eye corners and the shield emblem on its collar.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：红眼角与项圈上的盾徽铜牌。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the red eye corners and the shield tag on its collar.

subject.en: An old wolf about 1.7 m long on four legs, usually lying down; its fur so pale it is almost white #D8D8D0, the tips with a slight porcelain sheen, yet the corners of its eyes are red #B33A2A as if it had just been weeping; an old leather collar round its neck with a brass tag stamped with a shield emblem #B08A4A; it stays still unless provoked, then pounces with frost; identifying marks: the whitened fur, the red eye corners and the shield emblem on its collar.

extra.zh: 整张图的所有帧都朝画面右方（侧面）。
extra.en: Every frame in this sheet faces screen right (side view).

subject.zh: 站高约 3 米的血斑亚龙，后腿双足站立，膜翼、长颈长尾；鳞片暗青灰 #4A5560，脸颊、颈与翼膜上的血斑又多又红 #B33A2A，密得像雀斑；嘴边总叼着一根断掉的酒桶箍 #6A5038；以扑咬、甩尾、喷火攻击；辨识：满脸红雀斑与嘴边的酒桶箍。
subject.en: A bloodspot drake about 3 m tall standing on its hind legs, with membrane wings, long neck and long tail; dark blue-gray scales #4A5560, the blood spots on its cheeks, neck and wing membranes many and bright red #B33A2A, dense as freckles; a broken barrel hoop #6A5038 always hangs from its jaws; bites, lashes its tail and breathes fire; identifying marks: the face full of red freckles and the barrel hoop at its mouth.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：满脸红雀斑与嘴边的酒桶箍。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the red freckles and the barrel hoop at its mouth.

subject.zh: 站高约 4.2 米的骸鳞亚龙，后腿双足、巨大膜翼、长颈长尾；骨架是古老的灰白龙骨 #E0D8C8，新鳞暗灰 #4A4A50，颈下一片倒长的大鳞泛淡紫 #C6B5E0；眼角挂着暗红的泪痕 #8A2A2A；以吐息、扑咬、震慑攻击；辨识：颈下那片倒长的逆鳞与眼角的红泪痕。
subject.en: A bonescale drake about 4.2 m tall on its hind legs, with huge membrane wings, long neck and long tail; a frame of ancient gray-white dragon bone #E0D8C8 with new dark gray scales #4A4A50, one large reversed scale under its throat tinged pale lavender #C6B5E0; dark red tear streaks #8A2A2A at the corners of its eyes; breathes, bites and terrifies; identifying marks: the reversed scale under its throat and the red tear streaks.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：颈下倒长的逆鳞与红泪痕。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the reversed throat scale and the red tear streaks.

subject.zh: 翼展约 3.5 米的巨大猛禽，两足两翼；羽色深褐 #5A3E28，头颈一圈蓬松的金色鬃羽 #D8A840 像狮鬃，钩喙铅灰；背脊与肩羽间冒出几枚赤黑骨刺 #5A1A16；以俯冲抓击、尖啸震慑攻击；辨识：头颈的金鬃与背上的赤黑骨刺。
subject.en: A huge raptor with a wingspan of about 3.5 m, two legs and two wings; dark brown plumage #5A3E28, a fluffy ruff of golden mane feathers #D8A840 around the head and neck like a lion's mane, a lead-gray hooked beak; a few red-black bony spurs #5A1A16 jut between the spine and the shoulder feathers; attacks with diving grabs and a stunning shriek; identifying marks: the golden mane and the red-black spurs on its back.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：头颈的金色鬃羽与铅灰钩喙。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the golden mane ruff and the lead-gray hooked beak.

subject.zh: 高约 0.6 米的一团冷却炉渣，静止时缩成一块大狗头金 #C9A227 卧在渣堆里；醒来时黑灰渣壳 #3A3634 裂开，伸出几条短粗渣足，裂缝透出黄铜色微光，正面一道横裂的嘴专吞钱币；以渣足拍打、偷钱攻击；辨识：顶上始终留着一块假金。
subject.en: A lump of cooled slag about 0.6 m high that, at rest, shrinks into a big gold nugget #C9A227 lying in a slag heap; when it wakes the black-gray slag crust #3A3634 cracks open, a few stubby slag feet push out, brass-colored light shows in the cracks, and a horizontal split mouth in front swallows coins; attacks by slapping with its slag feet and stealing money; identifying mark: a lump of fake gold always left on its top.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：裂开的渣壳、横裂的嘴与顶上的假金。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the cracked slag crust, the split mouth and the fake gold on top.

subject.zh: 高约 0.6 米的一团冷却炉渣，静止时缩成一块大狗头金 #C9A227 卧在渣堆里；醒来时黑灰渣壳 #3A3634 裂开，伸出几条短粗渣足，裂缝透出黄铜色微光，正面一道横裂的嘴专吞钱币；以渣足拍打、偷钱攻击；辨识：顶上始终留着一块假金。
subject.en: A lump of cooled slag about 0.6 m high that, at rest, shrinks into a big gold nugget #C9A227 lying in a slag heap; when it wakes the black-gray slag crust #3A3634 cracks open, a few stubby slag feet push out, brass-colored light shows in the cracks, and a horizontal split mouth in front swallows coins; attacks by slapping with its slag feet and stealing money; identifying mark: a lump of fake gold always left on its top.

extra.zh: 整张图的所有帧都面向镜头（朝下）。
extra.en: Every frame in this sheet faces the viewer (down).

items.notes: 附 art_mon_dross_goldmimic_ref 作参照，保持外形与配色，允许姿势变化。它没有明显朝向：只出这一张正面图，游戏里各朝向共用。像素画成不透明实色，半透明与发光由渲染层加。待机行画成一块静止的狗头金（拟态），醒来才裂开伸足；假金用暖金，不用门扉金。与 art_mon_slag_golem_ref 的人形渣块、art_mon_chest_mimic_ref 的木箱区分。

subject.zh: 体长约五米的成年飞蜥，后腿双足站立，前肢是宽大的皮翼，长颈长尾；浅青灰细鳞 #7AA0C4、#C8D4DC，腹鳞更浅，头顶两支向后弯的角，嘴边常冒几点小火星；以扑咬、甩尾、吐弱火攻击；辨识：翼膜上几道晒得发白的旧褶痕。
subject.en: An adult skywyrm about five meters long, standing on two hind legs, its forelimbs broad skin wings, long neck and long tail; fine pale blue-gray scales #7AA0C4, #C8D4DC, paler on the belly, two horns curving back from its head, a few small sparks often at the corners of its mouth; attacks by biting, tail lashing and a weak fire breath; identifying mark: a few old sun-bleached creases across its wing membranes.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：后弯的双角与翼膜上发白的褶痕。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the two back-curving horns and the bleached creases on the wing membrane.

subject.zh: 站高约 5.5 米、形似龙的大飞蜥，后腿双足站立，皮翼宽大，长颈长尾；鳞片褪成黯哑的灰白 #A8A8B0，头上的角长成一圈歪斜的冠，颈背冒出几簇淡紫晶刺 #C6B5E0，眼睛浑浊；以扑咬、劈爪、吐烟火攻击；辨识：轮廓像龙，鳞面却毫无光泽。
subject.en: A great skywyrm about 5.5 m tall that has grown to look like a dragon, standing on two hind legs, broad skin wings, long neck and long tail; its scales faded to a dull gray-white #A8A8B0, its horns grown into a ragged, crooked crown, clusters of pale violet crystal spikes #C6B5E0 on its neck and back, clouded eyes; attacks by biting, raking claws and a smoky fire breath; identifying mark: a dragon's outline with scales that have no shine at all.

extra.zh: 第 4 格特写：参差歪斜的角冠与颈背的淡紫晶刺。
extra.en: Panel 4 close-up: the ragged crooked horn crown and the pale violet crystal spikes on its neck.
